example: The company has introduced random drug testing of its employees.
translation: 公司已实行对雇员的随机毒品测试。

meaning: n. 下降；衰退；斜面; v. 下降；衰落；谢绝
example: Official figures show a sharp decline in the number of foreign tourists.
translation: 官方数字显示外国游客数量骤降。

meaning: adj. 客观的；目标的；宾格的; n. 目的；目标；[光] 物镜；宾格
example: Scientists need to be objective when doing research.
translation: 科学家做研究时要客观。

meaning: v. 刺，戳；伸出；粘贴; n. 棍；手杖；呆头呆脑的人
example: This stamp won’t stick properly.
translation: 这张邮票贴不牢。

meaning: n. 因素；要素；[物] 因数；代理人; v. 做代理商
example: The rise in crime is mainly due to social and economic factors.
translation: 犯罪率上升主要由社会和经济因素造成。

meaning: n. 铁轨；扶手；横杆；围栏; v. 抱怨；责骂
example: Several passengers were leaning against the ship’s rail.
translation: 几名乘客斜靠在轮船的栏杆上。

meaning: v. 落下；变成；来临；减弱; n. 下降；秋天；瀑布; adj. 秋天的
example: The tree was about to fall.
translation: 那棵树快要倒下了。

meaning: v. 参考；涉及；提到；查阅
example: In his speech, he referred to a recent trip to Canada.
translation: 在他的讲话中，他提到了最近的加拿大之行。

meaning: adj. 短的；不足的；矮的，低的; n. 短；缺乏；短路；短裤; adv. 不足；突然；唐突地
example: Morris gave a short laugh.
translation: 莫里斯笑了一声。

meaning: n. 论证；论据；争吵；内容提要
example: We need to provide a convincing argument as to why the system should be changed.
translation: 我们得提出有说服力的论据，证明为何要改变体制。

meaning: v. 分派任务; n. 工作，作业；任务
example: Jen was tasked with running a charity basketball tournament.
translation: 珍被委以举办一场慈善篮球赛的任务。

meaning: v. 管理；经营；控制；设法
example: He was asked to manage a new department.
translation: 他被要求去管理一个新的部门。

meaning: adj. 低的，浅的；卑贱的；粗俗的；消沉的; adv. 低声地；谦卑地，低下地; n. 低；低价；低点；牛叫声; v. 牛叫
example: Their safety standards seem to be pretty low.
translation: 他们的安全标准似乎相当低。

meaning: n. 存在；出席；参加；风度；仪态
example: Your presence is requested at the club meeting on Friday.
translation: 敬请出席于周五举行的俱乐部会议。

meaning: v. 使比赛；使相配；敌得过，比得上；相配；与…竞争; n. 比赛，竞赛；匹配；对手；火柴
example: We painted the cabinets green to match the rug.
translation: 我们把柜子刷成绿色，和地毯相配。

meaning: n. 平行线；对比; v. 使…与…平行; adj. 平行的；类似的，相同的
example: ...the area south of the 38th parallel.
translation: …38度纬线以南的地区。

meaning: adj. 军事的；军人的；适于战争的; n. 军队；军人
example: The government has threatened to take military action if the rebels do not withdraw from the area.
translation: 政府警告说，如果叛乱分子不从该地区撤出，就要采取军事行动。

meaning: n. 冲突，矛盾；斗争；争执; v. 冲突，抵触；争执；战斗
example: Marx points out the potential conflicts below the surface of society.
translation: 马克思指出了隐藏在社会表层之下的潜在矛盾。

meaning: adv. 可能地；也许；大概
example: This last task is possibly the most difficult.
translation: 这最后一项任务也许是最难的。

meaning: n. 有瘾的人；入迷的人; v. 使沉溺；使上瘾
example: She is a TV addict and watches as much as she can.
translation: 她是一个电视迷，看尽可能多的电视。

meaning: n. 欢乐，快乐；乐趣；高兴; v. 欣喜，欢喜
example: The garden was his pride and joy.
translation: 这座花园是他的骄傲和乐趣所在。

meaning: v. 使…困惑；使…为难；苦思而得出; n. 谜；难题；迷惑
example: He was puzzled by the reactions to his remark.
translation: 他对自己的话引起的反应感到困惑不解。

meaning: v. 画；拉；吸引; n. 平局；抽签
example: Katie had drawn a cottage with a little stream running next to it.
translation: 凯蒂画了一间小茅舍，旁边流淌着一条小溪。

meaning: v. 开车；猛击；飞跑; n. 驱动器；驾车；[心理] 内驱力，推进力；快车道
example: So when did you learn to drive ?
translation: 那么你是什么时候学会开车的？

meaning: v. 对比；形成对照; n. 对比；差别；对照物
example: an essay comparing and contrasting (= showing how two things are similar and different ) Verdi and Wagner and their operas
translation: 把威尔第和瓦格纳以及他们的歌剧进行比较和对照的一篇文章

meaning: n. 背景；隐蔽的位置; v. 作…的背景; adj. 背景的；发布背景材料的
example: Students with a background in chemistry will probably find the course easier.
translation: 学过化学的学生可能会觉得这门课程容易些。

meaning: n. 墙壁，围墙；似墙之物; v. 用墙围住，围以墙; adj. 墙壁的
example: We climbed over the wall into the orchard.
translation: 我们翻墙进了果园。

meaning: n. 艺术家；美术家（尤指画家）；大师
example: an exhibition of paintings by local artists
translation: 当地画家的画展

meaning: n. 通讯，[通信] 通信；交流；信函
example: Good communication is vital in a large organization.
translation: 在大机构里良好的沟通是极为重要的。

meaning: v. 使化合；使联合，使结合; n. 联合收割机；联合企业
example: Diets are most effective when combined with exercise.
translation: 节食和锻炼相结合是最有效的。

meaning: n. 字母表，字母系统；入门，初步
example: The modern Russian alphabet has 31 letters.
translation: 现代俄语字母表有31个字母。

meaning: v. 打架；与…打仗，与…斗争；反对…提案; n. 打架；战斗，斗志
example: Neither country is capable of fighting a long war .
translation: 两个国家都没有能力打持久战。

meaning: n. 危机；危险期；决定性时刻; adj. 危机的；用于处理危机的
example: The country now faces an economic crisis .
translation: 该国目前正面临一场经济危机。

meaning: v. 批准；赞成；为…提供证据
example: The conference approved a proposal for a referendum.
translation: 会议通过了举行全民公决的提议。

meaning: n. 协议；同意，一致
example: It is easier for two parties to reach agreement than for three.
translation: 两方达成一致比三方达成一致容易。

meaning: n. 惊奇，诧异；突然袭击; v. 使惊奇；奇袭; adj. 令人惊讶的
example: The man had a look of surprise on his face.
translation: 那人脸上一副惊讶的表情。

meaning: v. 想像；猜想；臆断
example: Perhaps she’d never really been there at all – perhaps she’d just imagined it.
translation: 可能她从未到过那儿——也许这都是她的幻想。

meaning: adj. 可靠的；可信赖的; n. 可靠的人
example: Miller was a quiet and reliable man.
translation: 米勒是个话不多且可靠的人。

meaning: v. 收集；募捐; adv. 由收件人付款地; adj. 由收件人付款的
example: After 25 years of collecting recipes, she has compiled them into a cookbook.
translation: 她搜集了25年食谱，把它们编成一本烹饪书。

meaning: v. 忘记；忽略
example: I’m sorry, I’ve forgotten your name.
translation: 对不起，我忘记你的名字了。

meaning: adj. 最高的；至高的；最重要的; n. 至高；霸权
example: the Supreme Allied Commander in Europe
translation: 欧洲盟军最高指挥官

meaning: n. 张力；拉紧；负担；扭伤；血缘; v. 拉紧；尽力
example: I couldn’t look after him any more; the strain was too much for me.
translation: 我不能再照看他了，压力太大。

meaning: adj. 准备好；现成的；迅速的；情愿的；快要…的; n. 现款；预备好的状态; adv. 迅速地；预先; v. 使准备好
example: Come on. Aren’t you ready yet?
translation: 快点，你还没准备好吗？

meaning: adj. 保守的; n. 保守派，守旧者
example: a very conservative attitude to education
translation: 对待教育非常守旧的态度

meaning: v. 消耗，消费；使…著迷；挥霍
example: Only 27% of the paper we consume is recycled.
translation: 我们消耗的纸张只有 27% 得到回收利用。

meaning: v. 否定，否认；拒绝给予；拒绝…的要求
example: The government denied the existence of poverty among 16- and 17-year-olds.
translation: 政府否认十六七岁的青少年当中存在贫困问题。

meaning: v. 追溯；沿路走; n. 痕迹，踪迹；微量；[仪] 迹线；缰绳
example: Sondheim’s book traces the changing nature of the relationship between men and women.
translation: 桑德海姆的这本书研究了男女关系性质的变化。

meaning: v. 吸引，占用；使参加；雇佣；使订婚；预定
example: She engaged the clutch and the car moved.
translation: 她踩下离合器，汽车便开动了。

meaning: v. 消失；失踪；不复存在
example: At this point the path seemed to disappear altogether (= disappear completely ) .
translation: 小路到这里好像完全消失了。

meaning: n. 损害；损毁；赔偿金; v. 损害；损毁
example: These chemicals have been found to cause serious environmental damage.
translation: 经发现，这些化学物质会造成严重的环境破坏。

meaning: n. 痛苦，悲惨；不幸；苦恼；穷困
example: What we are witnessing here is human misery on a vast scale.
translation: 我们在这里所目睹的情景是许许多多的人都生活困苦。

meaning: n. 节约；挽救；存款; adj. 节约的；挽救的；补偿的；保留的; prep. 考虑到；除之外
example: Buying a house had taken all their savings.
translation: 买房子花掉了他们所有的积蓄。

meaning: v. 使心烦；颠覆；扰乱; adj. 心烦的；混乱的；弄翻的; n. 混乱；翻倒；颠覆
example: Don’t do anything that would upset him.
translation: 别做惹他生气的事情。

meaning: n. 首领；酋长；主要部分; adj. 首席的；主要的；主任的; adv. 主要地；首要地
example: Most health chiefs believe the reforms have gone too far.
translation: 大多数卫生部领导人都觉得改革搞得过火了。

meaning: adj. 被俘虏的；被迷住的; n. 俘虏；迷恋者
example: Her heart had begun to pound inside her chest like a captive animal.
translation: 她心如鹿撞，怦怦跳个不停。

meaning: n. 意见；主张
example: When choosing an insurance policy it’s best to get an independent opinion.
translation: 选择保险时，最好听听专家的独立意见。

meaning: n. 谅解，理解；理解力；协议; adj. 了解的；聪明的；有理解力的; v. 理解；明白（understand的ing形式）
example: We had an understanding that Jean-Claude should never be mentioned.
translation: 我们有一个共识，永远不提让－克洛德。

meaning: n. 购买；紧握；起重装置; v. 购买；赢得
example: She paid for her purchases and left.
translation: 她付钱买好东西离开了。

meaning: adj. 能干的，能胜任的；有才华的
example: a strong capable woman
translation: 一个坚强能干的女人

meaning: n. 间隙；缺口；差距；分歧; v. 裂开
example: a gap in the traffic
translation: 车流中的一个空档

meaning: n. 残余；遗骸
example: extensive Roman remains (= of ancient buildings ) at Arles
translation: 阿尔勒的一大片古罗马遗迹

meaning: n. 职员；参谋；棒；支撑; adj. 职员的；行政工作的; v. 供给人员；给…配备职员
example: The entire staff has done an outstanding job this year.
translation: 今年全体员工工作都非常出色。

meaning: n. 气氛；大气；空气
example: The hotel had a lovely relaxed atmosphere .
translation: 那家宾馆的气氛轻松愉快。

meaning: v. 判断；审判; n. 法官；裁判员
example: You should never judge a person by their looks.
translation: 决不要以貌取人。

meaning: v. 描绘…的特性；具有…的特征
example: Bright colours characterize his paintings.
translation: 明亮的色彩是他绘画作品的特点。

meaning: n. 葡萄；葡萄酒；葡萄树；葡萄色
example: a bunch of grapes
translation: 一串葡萄

meaning: v. 使混乱；使困惑
example: I understand the text but the diagrams are confusing me.
translation: 文字我理解，但是图表把我弄糊涂了。

meaning: n. 意义；含义；意图; adj. 意味深长的; v. 意味；意思是（mean的ing形式）
example: Life seemed to have lost its meaning since Janet’s death.
translation: 珍妮特去世以后生活似乎失去了意义。

meaning: n. 建筑；建筑物; v. 建筑；建立；增加（build的ing形式）
example: The offices are on the top two floors of the building.
translation: 办公室在大楼最高的两层。

meaning: n. 招聘；新兵；新成员; v. 补充；聘用；征募；使…恢复健康
example: New recruits are sent to the Atlanta office for training.
translation: 新成员被送到亚特兰大办事处接受培训。

meaning: n. 失败；故障；失败者；破产
example: Successful people often aren’t very good at dealing with failure.
translation: 一帆风顺的人往往不太擅长应对失败。

meaning: v. 责备；归咎于; n. 责备；责任；过失
example: Don’t blame me – it’s not my fault.
translation: 别来怪我——又不是我的错。

meaning: n. 定义；[物] 清晰度；解说
example: a dictionary definition
translation: 词典里的释义

meaning: adj. 统一的；一致的；相同的；均衡的；始终如一的; n. 制服; v. 使穿制服；使成一样
example: Grade A eggs must be of uniform size.
translation: A 级鸡蛋必须大小相同。

meaning: n. 旅馆，饭店；客栈; v. 使…在饭店下榻; v. 进行旅馆式办公
example: I’ve booked the flights and the hotel.
translation: 我已订好机票和酒店。

meaning: adj. 智能的；聪明的；理解力强的
example: Sontag was once famously described as the most intelligent woman in America.
translation: 桑塔格曾被称为美国最聪明的女人，这是众人皆知的事。

meaning: n. 偏见；偏爱；斜纹；乖离率; v. 使存偏见; adj. 偏斜的; adv. 偏斜地
example: Students were evaluated without bias.
translation: 对学生的评估都是公正的。

meaning: n. [计] 选项；选择权；买卖的特权
example: There are a number of options available.
translation: 有多种选择。

meaning: n. 日期；约会；年代；枣椰子; v. 过时；注明日期；始于（某一历史时期）
example: The date on the letter was 30th August 1962.
translation: 信上的日期是1962年8月30日。

meaning: n. 描述，描写；类型；说明书
example: The booklet gives a brief description of each place.
translation: 这本小册子对每一个地方都作了简短的介绍。

meaning: adj. 特殊的；独特的；奇怪的；罕见的; n. 特权；特有财产
example: There was a peculiar smell in the kitchen.
translation: 厨房里有一股怪味。

meaning: v. 维持；继续；维修；主张；供养
example: Careers Officers maintain contact with young people when they have left school.
translation: 年轻人离开学校以后，职业指导员和他们保持联系。

meaning: v. 消除；排除
example: a ruthless dictator who eliminated all his rivals
translation: 铲除所有异己的残酷独裁者

meaning: n. 真理；事实；诚实；实质
example: How do we know you’re telling us the truth?
translation: 我们怎么知道你告诉我们的是真话？

meaning: n. 历史学家
example: I am a historian, and I teach in an American university.
translation: 我是一位历史学家，在美国一所大学任教。

meaning: n. 企图，试图；攻击; v. 企图，试图；尝试
example: He made no attempt to hide his anger.
translation: 他毫不掩饰自己的愤怒。

meaning: n. 出生；血统，出身；起源
example: Congratulations on the birth of your daughter!
translation: 恭喜你生了个女儿！

meaning: n. 主题（等于theme）；题目；一般规则；总论
example: The environment is a popular topic these days.
translation: 如今环境是一个热门话题。

meaning: n. 块；件；篇；硬币; v. 修补；接合；凑合
example: Cut off a piece of wood 5 cm in length.
translation: 截下一段五厘米长的木头。

meaning: adj. 完整的；完全的；彻底的; v. 完成
example: The police were in complete control of the situation.
translation: 警方已完全控制了局势。

meaning: v. 排除；排斥；拒绝接纳；逐出
example: The judges decided to exclude evidence which had been unfairly attained.
translation: 法官裁决不接纳以不正当手段获取的证据。

meaning: n. [物] 能量；精力；活力；精神
example: The water is heated using energy from the sun.
translation: 水是利用太阳能加热的。

meaning: v. 娱乐；招待；怀抱；容纳
example: Mark usually does the cooking when we entertain.
translation: 我们招待客人时通常都是马克下厨。

meaning: n. 增加；利润；收获; v. 获得；增加；赚到
example: The Democratic Party needed a net gain of only 20 votes.
translation: 民主党只需要增20张选票。

meaning: adj. 吸引人的；有魅力的；引人注目的
example: Women seem to find him attractive .
translation: 女性似乎觉得他很有吸引力。

meaning: v. 关闭；停业；幽禁; n. 关闭; adj. 关闭的；围绕的
example: Shut the window, Ellen!
translation: 埃伦，把窗关上！

meaning: n. 玫瑰；粉红色；蔷薇（花）；粉红色的葡萄酒; adj. 玫瑰花的；玫瑰色的；粉红色的；带有玫瑰香味的; v. 使成玫瑰色，使（面颊）发红；使有玫瑰香味; v. 起义( rise的过去式)；升起；（数量）增加；休会
example: A large bouquet of roses arrived on her desk.
translation: 一大束玫瑰送到了她的桌子上。

meaning: n. 黄瓜；胡瓜
example: The "gurkophone" is one of their classics, made from a hollowed cucumber, a pepper and a carrot.
translation: 黄瓜管"是他们的经典乐器之一,那是用掏空的黄瓜、辣椒和胡萝卜做的。

meaning: n. 程序，手续；步骤
example: On board, we were given the usual talk on safety procedures (= what to do if an accident happens, or to prevent an accident ) .
translation: 在飞机上，我们听了例行的飞行安全讲解。

meaning: v. 决定；解决；判决
example: Has anything been decided yet?
translation: 已经作出什么决定了吗？

meaning: n. 编者，编辑；社论撰写人；编辑装置
example: the editor of a book of essays on modern poetry
translation: 现代诗歌论文集的编者

meaning: v. 幸存；生还；幸免于；比活得长
example: Only 12 of the 140 passengers survived.
translation: 140 名乘客中只有 12 人生还。

meaning: v. 证明；展示；论证
example: The study demonstrates the link between poverty and malnutrition.
translation: 这项研究证明了贫困与营养不良之间的联系。

meaning: adj. 学术的；理论的；学院的; n. 大学生，大学教师；学者
example: He possessed no academic qualifications.
translation: 他没有学历。

meaning: n. 经济学；国家的经济状况
example: a Harvard professor of economics
translation: 哈佛大学的经济学教授

meaning: adj. 典型的；特有的；表示特性的; n. 特征；特性；特色
example: the highly characteristic (= very typical ) flint walls of the local houses
translation: 当地房子非常有特色的燧石墙

meaning: v. 说服；使确信，使信服
example: Her arguments didn’t convince everyone, but changes were made.
translation: 她的论点不能说服每个人，但还是引起了一些变化。

meaning: adj. 重要的；物质的，实质性的；肉体的; n. 材料，原料；物资；布料
example: According to some, the material world is all that exists.
translation: 有些人认为，物质世界就是存在的一切。

meaning: n. 树；木料；树状物; v. 把赶上树
example: As a kid, I loved to climb trees.
translation: 小时候，我喜欢爬树。

meaning: v. 反对；对抗，抗争
example: Congress is continuing to oppose the President’s health care budget.
translation: 国会继续反对总统的医疗保健预算。

meaning: n. [劳经] 报酬；报答；酬谢; v. [劳经] 奖励；奖赏
example: The school has a system of rewards and punishments to encourage good behaviour.
translation: 学校有奖惩制度以鼓励良好行为。

meaning: adj. 理想的；完美的；想象的；不切实际的; n. 理想；典范
example: The scheme offers an ideal opportunity for youngsters to get training.
translation: 该计划为年轻人提供了获得培训的极好机会。

meaning: adj. 最初的；字首的; v. 用姓名的首字母签名; n. 词首大写字母
example: The initial response has been encouraging.
translation: 最初的反应情况很乐观。

meaning: v. 投合，迎合；满足需要；提供饮食及服务
example: We cater to an exclusive clientele.
translation: 我们满足一个特殊客户群的需求。

meaning: n. 职业，专业；声明，宣布，表白
example: people who work in the professions
translation: 从事专业性工作的人

meaning: v. 竞争；比赛；对抗
example: He will be competing in the 100-metre race.
translation: 他将参加100米比赛。

meaning: adj. 先进的；高级的；晚期的；年老的; v. 前进；增加；上涨（advance的过去式和过去分词形式）
example: advanced weapon systems
translation: 先进的武器系统

meaning: n. 基础；底部；主要成分；基本原则或原理
example: Their claim had no basis in fact (=  it was not true  ) .
translation: 他们的说法没有事实根据。

meaning: v. 误导；带错
example: Don’t be misled by appearances, he’s a good worker.
translation: 不要被表象迷惑，他工作干得挺不错的。

meaning: v. 面对；遭遇；比较
example: The problems confronting the new government were enormous.
translation: 新政府面临的难题是巨大的。

meaning: adj. 全部的，整个的；全体的
example: It was the worst day in my entire life.
translation: 那是我一生中最糟糕的一天。

meaning: adj. 相反的；对立的; adv. 相反地; n. 相反；反面
example: Two contrary views emerged.
translation: 出现了两种相反的观点。

meaning: adj. 实际的；实用性的
example: Candidates should have training and practical experience in basic electronics.
translation: 应征者应该具备基础电子学方面的培训和实践经验。

meaning: v. 变化；变异；违反
example: Quentin’s mood seems to vary according to the weather.
translation: 昆廷的情绪似乎随天气而变化。

meaning: v. 继续；从事；追赶；纠缠
example: She plans to pursue a career in politics.
translation: 她计划从政。

meaning: adj. 暂时的，临时的; n. 临时工，临时雇员
example: I’m living with my parents, but it’s only temporary.
translation: 我和父母住在一起，但这只是暂时的。

meaning: adj. 戏剧的；急剧的；引人注目的；激动人心的
example: A superb goal by Owen earned United a dramatic victory yesterday.
translation: 昨天欧文的一个超级入球为联队赢得了激动人心的胜利。

meaning: adj. 易受攻击的，易受…的攻击；易受伤害的；有弱点的
example: He took advantage of me when I was at my most vulnerable.
translation: 他在我最脆弱的时候利用了我。

meaning: v. 代表；表现；描绘；回忆；再赠送
example: Mr Kobayashi was chosen to represent the company at the conference.
translation: 小林先生被选中代表公司出席会议。

meaning: n. 发明；发明物；虚构；发明才能
example: The dishwasher is a wonderful invention.
translation: 洗碗机是一项奇妙的发明。

meaning: n. 丰富，大量；充足; adj. 足够的，很多的; adv. 足够
example: a land of plenty
translation: 一片富饶的土地

meaning: v. 收集；收割；使…聚集；使…皱起; n. 聚集；衣褶；收获量
example: A crowd gathered to watch the fight.
translation: 一群人聚拢来围观打架。

meaning: adj. 公民的；民间的；文职的；有礼貌的；根据民法的
example: They were married in a civil ceremony in May.
translation: 他们在五月份举行了世俗婚礼。

meaning: n. 罪犯; adj. 刑事的；犯罪的；罪恶的
example: Police have described the man as a violent and dangerous criminal.
translation: 警方形容那名男子是个凶暴而危险的罪犯。

meaning: v. 铭刻于，铭记；打烙印于；印…商标于; n. 商标，牌子；烙印
example: The owner couldn't be bothered to brand the cattle.
translation: 主人懒得给这牛打上烙印。

meaning: v. 使兴旺；发隆隆声; n. 繁荣；吊杆；隆隆声
example: Guns boomed in the distance.
translation: 远处大炮隆隆作响。

meaning: adj. 系统的；体系的；有系统的；[图情] 分类的；一贯的，惯常的
example: They went about their business in a systematic way.
translation: 他们按部就班地做生意。

meaning: adj. 大量的；实质的；内容充实的; n. 本质；重要材料
example: We have the support of a substantial number of parents.
translation: 我们有相当多家长的支持。

meaning: n. 开始；机会；通路；空缺的职位; adj. 开始的; v. 开放（open的ing形式）；打开；公开
example: There are very few openings in scientific research.
translation: 科学研究领域很少有职位空缺。

meaning: adj. 有趣的；引起兴趣的，令人关注的
example: That’s an interesting question.
translation: 那是一个有趣的问题。

meaning: adj. 组成的，构成的; n. 成分；组件；[电子] 元件
example: Gorbachev failed to keep the component parts of the Soviet Union together.
translation: 戈尔巴乔夫没能使苏联各组成部分保持在一起。

meaning: n. 垃圾；废物; v. 拒绝；不愿；抵制
example: a refuse dump
translation: 垃圾场

meaning: n. 药；医学；内科；巫术; v. 用药物治疗；给…用药
example: Medicines should be kept out of the reach of children.
translation: 药应放在孩子够不到的地方。

meaning: n. 快乐；希望；娱乐；令人高兴的事; v. 使高兴；使满意; v. 高兴；寻欢作乐
example: the simple pleasures of life
translation: 生活中的简单乐趣

meaning: n. 队；组; v. 使合作
example: Which team do you support?
translation: 你支持哪个队？

meaning: n. 商品；动产；合意的人；真本领
example: There will be tax increases on a range of goods and services .
translation: 有一些商品和服务将要增税。

meaning: v. 修改，修饰；更改
example: The feedback will be used to modify the course for next year.
translation: 这些反馈意见将用于修改明年的课程。

meaning: n. 运动；游戏；娱乐；运动会；玩笑; v. 游戏; adj. 运动的
example: the sport of falconry
translation: 放鹰狩猎运动

meaning: n. 投票，选举；选票；得票数; v. 提议，使投票；投票决定；公认
example: A vote for us is not a wasted vote.
translation: 投我们的票是不会白投的。

meaning: n. 剂量；一剂，一服; v. 服药
example: I quite like Jamie in small doses (= in limited amounts but not a lot or often ) .
translation: 如果偶尔在一起的话，我还是蛮喜欢杰米的。

meaning: n. 衣物；磨损；耐久性; v. 穿着；用旧；耗损；面露
example: Replace your trainers when they start to show signs of wear.
translation: 运动鞋开始出现磨损迹象就要更换。

meaning: n. 主题；主旋律；题目; adj. 以奇想主题布置的
example: The book’s theme is the conflict between love and duty.
translation: 本书的主题是爱与责任之间的冲突。

meaning: n. 北，北方; adj. 北方的；朝北的; adv. 在北方，向北方
example: Which way is north?
translation: 哪边是北？

meaning: n. 领导能力；领导阶层
example: The US must now take a firm leadership role.
translation: 美国现在必须扮演一个强有力的领导人角色。

meaning: n. 礼物；天赋；赠品; v. 赋予；向…赠送
example: The earrings were a gift from my aunt.
translation: 这副耳环是我姑姑送给我的礼物。

meaning: adj. 自由主义的；慷慨的；不拘泥的；宽大的; n. 自由主义者
example: These kinds of price controls go against all the financial principles of the free market liberals.
translation: 这些价格控制违反了支持自由市场的自由主义者的所有金融原则。

meaning: n. 保存，保持；保护
example: wildlife conservation
translation: 野生生物保护

meaning: n. 圆；循环；一回合；圆形物; adj. 圆的；完全的；大概的；肥胖的; adv. 在周围；迂回地；朝反方向；挨个; v. 完成；围捕；绕行；弄圆; prep. 附近；绕过；大约；在…周围
example: I played a round of golf on Sunday morning.
translation: 星期天早上我打了一场高尔夫球。

meaning: v. 坚持，强调
example: Stay for supper – I insist!
translation: 留下来吃晚餐——一定的！

meaning: n. 目标；物体；客体；宾语; v. 提出…作为反对的理由
example: an everyday object such as a spoon
translation: 调羹之类的日常用品

meaning: n. 表征；代币；记号; adj. 象征的；表意的；作为对某事的保证的; v. 象征；代表
example: ...slot-machine tokens.
translation: …自动贩卖机使用的代用币。

meaning: adj. 积极的；活跃的；主动的；有效的；现役的; n. 主动语态；积极分子
example: She’s over 80, but is still very active.
translation: 她80多岁了，但仍旧很活跃。

meaning: adj. 逐渐的；平缓的; n. 弥撒升阶圣歌集
example: There has been a gradual change in climate.
translation: 气候渐渐发生了变化。

meaning: adj. 不同的；多种多样的；变化多的
example: The building houses a wide and diverse variety of antiques.
translation: 这栋楼里摆放着大量各式各样的古董。

meaning: n. 俱乐部，社团；夜总会；棍棒；（扑克牌中的）梅花; v. 用棍棒打；募集; adj. 俱乐部的
example: Manchester United Football Club
translation: 曼联（队）足球俱乐部

meaning: n. 语法；语法书
example: Check your spelling and grammar.
translation: 检查你的拼写和语法。

meaning: adj. 狭窄的，有限的；勉强的；精密的；度量小的; n. 海峡；狭窄部分，隘路; v. 使变狭窄
example: The stairs were very narrow.
translation: 楼梯非常狭窄。

meaning: n. 任命；约定；任命的职位
example: All consultations are by appointment only .
translation: 就诊必须预约。

meaning: adj. 男性的；雄性的；有力的; n. 男人；雄性动物
example: Motor-racing has largely been a male preserve (= something that only men have been involved with ) .
translation: 赛车基本上是男人的专利。

meaning: n. 交易；事务；办理；会报，学报
example: The bank charges a fixed rate for each transaction.
translation: 银行对每一笔业务收取固定费用。

meaning: adj. 创造性的
example: This job is so boring. I wish I could do something more creative.
translation: 这工作太单调了，我希望能做些更有创造性的事情。

meaning: n. 代表；利益
example: She asked the doctor to speak to her parents on her behalf.
translation: 她请医生代她同她父母谈谈。

meaning: n. 才能；天才；天资
example: He has a lot of talent , and his work is fresh and interesting.
translation: 他很有天赋，作品新颖有趣。

meaning: adj. 微妙的；精细的；敏感的；狡猾的；稀薄的
example: The pictures are similar, but there are subtle differences between them.
translation: 这些图片很相似，但它们之间有细微的差别。

meaning: adj. 优先的；在先的，在前的; adv. 在前，居先
example: You do not need any prior knowledge of the subject.
translation: 你无需事先具备该方面的知识。

meaning: n. 责任；[税收] 关税；职务
example: I promise I will do my duty .
translation: 我保证会尽到我的责任。

meaning: n. 应用；申请；应用程序；敷用
example: We receive hundreds of job applications each year.
translation: 我们每年收到数百封求职信。

meaning: n. 印刷业；印花布；印刷字体；印章；印记; v. 印刷；打印；刊载；用印刷体写；在…印花样
example: There was no print at all on the backs of the tickets.
translation: 门票背面没有印任何文字。

meaning: adj. 向前的；早的；迅速的; adv. 向前地；向将来; v. 促进；转寄；运送; n. 前锋
example: Army roadblocks prevented any further forward movement .
translation: 有军队的路障，不能继续前行了。

meaning: n. 通知，布告；注意；公告; v. 通知；注意到；留心
example: I waved but they took no notice.
translation: 我挥了挥手，可是他们没有注意到。

meaning: n. 乐趣；玩笑；有趣的人或事; adj. 供娱乐用的; v. 开玩笑
example: There’s plenty of fun for all the family.
translation: 可以让全家人玩得很开心。

meaning: n. 财富；命运；运气; v. 给予财富; v. 偶然发生
example: I had the good fortune to work with a brilliant head of department.
translation: 我有幸与一位出色的部门主管共事。

meaning: adj. 富有的；肥沃的；昂贵的
example: Rich mineral deposits have been found in the sea bed.
translation: 海底发现有丰富的矿床。

meaning: n. 安全；保险；安全设备；保险装置；安打
example: You shouldn’t travel alone, for safety’s sake .
translation: 为安全起见，不要独自一人旅行。

meaning: n. 概念；见解；打算
example: She had no notion what he meant.
translation: 她根本不明白他是什么意思。

meaning: n. 前途；预期；景色; v. 勘探，找矿
example: I had no job, no education, and no prospects .
translation: 我没有工作，没受过什么教育，前途渺茫。

meaning: adj. 青少年的；幼稚的; n. 青少年；少年读物
example: The number of juveniles in the general population has fallen by a fifth in the past 10 years.
translation: 在过去的10年中，青少年在总人口中所占的比重下降了1/5。

meaning: v. 履行；实现；满足；使结束（等于fulfil）
v. 探索；探测；探险
example: Management need to explore ways of improving office security.
translation: 管理层需要探讨如何加强办事处的安全措施。

meaning: v. 使能够，使成为可能；授予权利或方法
example: The new test should enable doctors to detect the disease early.
translation: 新的检验使医生能在早期发现该种疾病。

meaning: n. 解决方案；溶液；溶解；解答
example: The best solution would be for them to separate.
translation: 最好的解决方法是他们分开。

meaning: n. 事情；事务；私事；（尤指关系不长久的）风流韵事
example: Are you interested in world affairs?
translation: 你对世界大事感兴趣吗？

meaning: adj. 慢的；减速的；迟钝的; v. 变慢；变萧条; adv. 慢慢地；迟缓地
example: The car was travelling at a very slow speed.
translation: 汽车正以非常慢的速度行驶。

meaning: adj. 意识到的；知道的；有…方面知识的；懂世故的
example: Mr Braley has been made aware of the need for absolute secrecy.
translation: 布雷利先生被告知需要绝对保密。

meaning: v. 加标签于；指派；对…开出交通违规罚单
example: How much does it say on the price ticket ?
translation: 价签上标明的价格是多少？

meaning: adj. 免疫的；免于……的，免除的; n. 免疫者；免除者
example: Once we’ve had the disease, we’re immune for life.
translation: 我们一旦得过这种病，就获得了终身免疫力。

meaning: n. 短语, 习语, 措辞, 乐句; v. 措词, 将(乐曲)分成乐句
example: Who first used the phrase ‘survival of the fittest’?
translation: “适者生存”这一说法最早是谁说的？

meaning: adj. 领导的；主要的; n. 领导；铅板；行距; v. 领导（lead的ing形式）
example: The army played a leading role in organizing the attempted coup.
translation: 军队在策划这场未遂政变的过程中起了最主要的作用。

meaning: v. 扩张；使膨胀；详述
example: The computer industry has expanded greatly over the last decade.
translation: 计算机行业在过去十年间大大地发展起来。

meaning: v. 给小费；翻倒；倾覆; n. 小费；尖端；小建议，小窍门；轻拍
example: Did you tip the waiter?
translation: 你给侍应生小费了吗？

meaning: v. 建议；打算，计划；求婚
example: the changes currently proposed by the local planning authorities
translation: 目前由地方规划局提议的改革

meaning: n. 预算，预算费; v. 安排，预定；把…编入预算; adj. 廉价的
example: We had a really tight budget .
translation: 我们的预算很紧。

meaning: v. 死亡；凋零；熄灭; n. 冲模，钢模；骰子
example: He died in 1985 at the age of 76.
translation: 他1985年去世，终年76岁。

meaning: v. 改变，使…变形；转换
example: Increased population has transformed the landscape.
translation: 人口的增加使景观发生了变化。

meaning: v. 参加；结合；连接; n. 结合；连接；接合点
example: Many sacrificed their weekend to join the hunt for the missing girl.
translation: 许多人牺牲周末时间，加入了寻找失踪女孩的行动。

meaning: n. 优先；优先权；[数] 优先次序；优先考虑的事
example: The club’s priority is to win the League.
translation: 该俱乐部首先考虑的是要赢得联赛。

meaning: v. 控制；支配；占优势；在…中占主要地位
example: The industry is dominated by five multinational companies.
translation: 这个行业受五家跨国公司控制。

meaning: v. 减弱，减少；放下，降下；贬低; adj. 下游的；下级的；下等的
example: Do you think we should lower the price?
translation: 你觉得我们应该降价吗？

meaning: n. 种类，分类；[数] 范畴
example: Seats are available in eight of the ten price categories .
translation: 座位共有10种票价，现有8种可售。

meaning: v. 分支；出现分歧; n. 树枝，分枝；分部；支流
example: When you reach the village green, the street branches into two .
translation: 到了村中心的公共草地，这条街就分岔成两条路。

meaning: adj. 重大的；有效的；有意义的；值得注意的；意味深长的; n. 象征；有意义的事物
example: His most significant political achievement was the abolition of the death penalty.
translation: 他政治上最重大的成就是废除了死刑。

meaning: v. 意味；暗示；隐含
example: an implied threat
translation: 隐含的威胁

meaning: n. 努力；尽力（等于endeavour）; v. 努力；尽力（等于endeavour）
example: She improved visibly from day to day, until Martin wondered if he was doing right, for he knew that all her compliance and endeavor was for his sake.
translation: 她一天比一天进步了，直到马丁怀疑起自己的做法是否得体。 因为他明白她的这一切迁就和努力都是为了他。

meaning: n. 性；性别；性行为；色情; v. 引起…的性欲；区别…的性别
example: All you see on TV is sex and violence these days.
translation: 如今在电视上看到的尽是性和暴力。

meaning: n. 男演员；行动者；作用物
example: His father was an actor in the Cantonese Opera Company.
translation: 他父亲曾是粤剧团的一名演员。

meaning: n. 法律顾问；忠告；商议；讨论；决策; v. 建议；劝告
example: He had always been able to count on her wise counsel.
translation: 他总是能够指望她明智的忠告。

meaning: adj. 符合习俗的，传统的；常见的；惯例的
example: Internet connections through conventional phone lines are fairly slow.
translation: 通过传统的电话线来连接因特网速度很慢。

meaning: v. 发展，进化；进化；使逐步形成；推断出
example: Animals have evolved camouflage to protect themselves from predators.
translation: 动物进化形成了伪装，以保护自身不被捕食性动物所捕食。

meaning: adj. 最差的，最坏的；最不利的；效能最低的; n. 最坏；最坏的时候; adv. 最坏地；最不利地
example: This is the worst recession for fifty years.
translation: 这是50年来最严重的一次经济衰退。

meaning: v. 估计，估价; n. 估计，估价；判断，看法
example: Try to estimate how many steps it will take to get to a close object.
translation: 估计一下需要多少步才能到达一个近距目标。

meaning: v. 评定；估价；对…征税
example: The test was to assess aptitude rather than academic achievement.
translation: 该测试将评估能力而不是学业成绩。

meaning: n. 实例；情况；建议; v. 举为例
example: We need to rethink the way we consume energy. Take, for instance, our approach to transport.
translation: 我们需要重新考虑我们使用能源的方式，例如我们的运输方式。

meaning: v. 批评；评论；非难
example: Ron does nothing but criticize and complain all the time.
translation: 罗恩什么也不干，只是一味指责和抱怨。

meaning: v. 致力；献身；题献
example: For the next few years, she dedicated herself to her work.
translation: 随后的几年里，她全身心地投入工作。

meaning: v. 妥协；危害; n. 妥协，和解；折衷
example: She admitted that she was unable to compromise.
translation: 她承认自己无法作出妥协。

meaning: adj. 第一的；最初的; n. 总理，首相
example: one of Dublin’s premier hotels
translation: 都柏林最好的酒店之一

meaning: v. 给加薪；给薪水; n. 薪水
example: The average salary for a teacher is $39,000 a year.
translation: 教师的平均工资是39,000美元一年。

meaning: n. 行星
example: The picture shows six of the nine planets in the solar system.
translation: 这张图片展示太阳系9个行星中的6个行星。

meaning: n. 大厅；休息室；会客室；游说议员的团体; v. 对……进行游说
example: I’ll meet you in the entrance lobby.
translation: 我们在入口大厅见。

meaning: v. 微笑; n. 微笑；笑容；喜色
example: her smiling face
translation: 她的笑脸

meaning: adv. 此外；而且
example: He is old and unpopular. Furthermore, he has at best only two years of political life ahead of him.
translation: 他年纪已老，又不得人心，而且他最多也只有两年的政治生命了。

meaning: n. 打赌，赌注；被打赌的事物; v. 打赌；敢断定，确信
example: Bookmakers are already taking bets on the outcome.
translation: 马票商已经开始接受对比赛结果的下注了。

meaning: adj. 竞争的；比赛的；求胜心切的
example: Competitive sports encourage children to work together as a team.
translation: 竞技体育鼓励孩子们进行团队协作。

meaning: n. 灌木；矮树丛; v. 以灌木装饰；使…精疲力竭; adj. 如灌木般长得低矮的；粗野的
example: The child was hiding in the bushes.
translation: 那孩子躲在灌木丛里。

meaning: n. 连接；关系；人脉；连接件
example: Police have so far failed to establish a connection between the two murders.
translation: 到目前为止警方尚未确定两宗凶杀案之间有关联。

meaning: n. 照片，图画；影片；景色；化身; v. 画；想像；描写
example: The room had several pictures on the walls.
translation: 那个房间墙上有几幅画。

meaning: adj. 认知的，认识的
example: cognitive psychology
translation: 认知心理学

meaning: v. 目的在于；引导；把…对准; n. 目的；目标；对准
example: Denver aimed his gun but did not shoot.
translation: 丹佛举枪瞄准，但是没有射击。

meaning: v. 给予，提供；买得起
example: The room affords a beautiful view over the city.
translation: 这房间可以俯瞰城市美景。

meaning: v. 引用；传讯；想起；表彰
example: The passage cited above is from a Robert Frost poem.
translation: 以上的引文出自罗伯特•弗罗斯特的一首诗。

meaning: adj. 典型的；特有的；象征性的
example: This advertisement is a typical example of their marketing strategy.
translation: 这则广告是他们营销策略的一个典型例子。

meaning: n. 运动；活动；运转；乐章
example: It's part of a broader nationalist movement that's gaining strength throughout the country.
translation: 这是一场正在全国范围内日益壮大的更为广泛的民族主义运动的一部分。

meaning: n. 贸易；商业；商务
example: measures promoting local commerce and industry
translation: 促进地方工商业发展的措施

meaning: adj. 普遍的；通用的；宇宙的；全世界的；全体的; n. 一般概念；普通性
example: These stories have universal appeal.
translation: 这些故事人人都喜欢。

meaning: n. 鼻子；嗅觉；突出的部分；探问; v. 嗅；用鼻子触
example: Someone punched him on the nose.
translation: 有人一拳打在他的鼻子上。

meaning: v. 恢复；修复；归还
example: She was hoping that the Mediterranean climate would restore her to full health.
translation: 她希望地中海的气候能使她的身体完全复原。

meaning: n. 四分之一；地区；季度；一刻钟；两角五分；节; v. 住宿；驻扎; num. 四分之一
example: It’s about a page and a quarter.
translation: 大概是一又四分之一页。

meaning: n. 意义；重要性；意思
example: Ideas about the social significance of religion have changed over time.
translation: 有关宗教的社会意义的观念已随时间的流逝发生了改变。

meaning: n. 精英；精华；中坚分子
example: a struggle for power within the ruling elite
translation: 统治阶层内部的争权夺利

meaning: n. 允许，许可
example: He asked permission to leave the room.
translation: 他请求离开房间的许可。

meaning: n. 管理；规则；校准; adj. 规定的；平常的
example: There seem to be so many rules and regulations these days.
translation: 如今好像条条框框很多。

meaning: v. 报价；引述；举证; n. 引用
example: He quoted a short passage from the Bible.
translation: 他引用了《圣经》里的一小段。

meaning: n. 垄断；垄断者；专卖权
example: a monopoly in copper trading
translation: 对铜交易的垄断

meaning: n. 焦虑；渴望；挂念；令人焦虑的事
example: A high level of anxiety was created by the introduction of cameras into the factory.
translation: 工厂安装了摄像头，这引起了工人的高度不安。

meaning: v. 节省；保存；储蓄；解救; prep. 除之外; n. 救援
example: He managed to save enough to buy a small house.
translation: 他想办法攒够钱买了一幢小房子。

meaning: n. 部长；大臣；牧师; v. 执行牧师职务；辅助或伺候某人
example: a senior Cabinet minister
translation: 资深的内阁部长

meaning: n. 性格，品质；特性；角色；[计] 字符; v. 印，刻；使具有特征
example: He has a cheerful but quiet character.
translation: 他的性格乐观文静。

meaning: adv. 高度地；非常；非常赞许地
example: Tom’s mother was highly critical of the school’s approach.
translation: 汤姆的母亲对学校的处理方法持强烈的批评态度。

meaning: n. 西；西方；西部; adj. 西方的；朝西的; adv. 在西方；向西方；自西方
example: There’s a slight chance of some sunshine in the west.
translation: 西部地区见晴的可能性不大。

meaning: n. 大学生；大学肄业生; adj. 大学生的
example: second-year undergraduates
translation: 大学二年级学生

meaning: v. 引起；唤醒；鼓励
example: Matt’s behavior was arousing the interest of the neighbors.
translation: 马特的行为渐渐引起了邻居的兴趣。

meaning: v. 运用，发挥；施以影响
example: They exerted considerable influence within the school.
translation: 他们在校内施加了很大的影响力。

meaning: n. 座位；所在地；职位; v. 使…坐下；可容纳…的；使就职
example: I was in the back seat and Jo was driving.
translation: 我在后座，乔开车。

meaning: v. 采取；接受；收养；正式通过
example: Sally was adopted when she was four.
translation: 莎莉四岁时被人收养。

meaning: n. 南方，南边；南部; adv. 在南方，向南方; adj. 南的，南方的
example: Which way is south?
translation: 哪面是南？

meaning: v. 挑选；选拔; adj. 精选的；挑选出来的；极好的; n. 被挑选者；精萃
example: a group of students selected at random
translation: 随机挑选出来的一组学生

meaning: n. 说明，解释；辩解
example: She told the court she would give a full explanation of the prosecution's decision on Monday.
translation: 她告诉法庭她将在星期一就控方的决定做出详尽的解释。

meaning: n. 论文；论点
example: Cynthia’s still working on her thesis.
translation: 辛西娅还在写论文。

meaning: v. 听（诊）；测量，测…深；使发声；试探；宣告; n. 声音，语音；噪音；海峡；吵闹；听力范围；[医] 探条; adj. 健全的，健康的；合理的；可靠的；有效彻底的; adv. 彻底地，充分地
example: Several earlier studies had sounded similar warnings .
translation: 早先的几次研究也提出过类似的警告。

meaning: adj. 定期的；有规律的；合格的；整齐的；普通的; n. 常客；正式队员；中坚分子; adv. 定期地；经常地
example: The company holds regular meetings with employees.
translation: 公司定期召集雇员开会。

meaning: n. 公司；法人（团体）；社团；大腹便便；市政当局
example: He works for a large American corporation.
translation: 他在一家美国大公司工作。

meaning: n. 倾泻；流出；骤雨; v. 灌，注；倒；倾泻；倾吐
example: She poured coffee for everyone.
translation: 她为每个人都倒了咖啡。

meaning: v. 造成，形成；摆姿势；装模作样；提出…讨论; n. 姿势，姿态；装模作样
example: Rising unemployment is posing serious problems for the administration.
translation: 失业率上升正在给政府造成严重的问题。

meaning: v. 察觉；发现；探测
example: Many forms of cancer can be cured if detected early.
translation: 如果发现得早，许多种癌症都可以治愈。

meaning: v. 躺；说谎；位于；展现; n. 谎言；位置
example: The town lies in a small wooded valley.
translation: 该城镇坐落于一个林木茂盛的山谷中。

meaning: n. 胜利，凯旋；欢欣; v. 获得胜利，成功
example: Winning the championship is a great personal triumph .
translation: 赢得冠军是伟大的个人成就。

meaning: v. 奋斗，努力；挣扎; n. 努力，奋斗；竞争
example: The team has been struggling all season.
translation: 整个赛季球队都打得很艰难。

meaning: adj. 不同的，不相似的; prep. 和…不同，不像
example: Tammy was unlike any other woman I have ever known.
translation: 塔米和我认识的其他女人都不一样。

meaning: adj. 强大的；强有力的; adv. 很；非常
example: He was one of the most powerful men in Bohemia.
translation: 他是波希米亚最有权势的人物之一。

meaning: adv. 最后，终于
example: He eventually escaped and made his way back to England.
translation: 他终于逃脱并返回英格兰。

meaning: n. 版本；译文；倒转术
example: the human version of mad cow disease
translation: 疯牛病的人类变体

meaning: adj. 不管的；不顾的；不注意的; adv. 不顾后果地；不管怎样，无论如何；不惜费用地
example: Despite her recent surgery she has been carrying on regardless.
translation: 尽管她最近动了手术，她却一直在不顾一切地继续工作。

meaning: n. 形状；模型；身材；具体化; v. 形成；塑造，使成形；使符合
example: What shape is the table?
translation: 那张桌子是什么形状的？

meaning: v. 滴；使降低；使终止；随口漏出; n. 滴；落下；空投；微量；滴剂
example: Temperatures can drop to freezing at night.
translation: 晚上气温能陡降到零度以下。

meaning: n. 跨度，跨距；范围; v. 跨越；持续；以手指测量
example: It is a very pretty butterfly, with a 2 inch wing span.
translation: 它是一只非常漂亮的蝴蝶，翅膀张开有2英寸宽。

meaning: adj. 相似的；相同的; adv. 以同样的方式；类似于
example: My mother and I are alike in many ways.
translation: 我和母亲在许多方面很相似。

meaning: adj. 皇家的；盛大的；女王的；高贵的；第一流的; n. 王室；王室成员
example: the royal palace
translation: 王宫

meaning: n. 补贴；津贴；补助金
example: European farmers are planning a massive demonstration against farm subsidy cuts.
translation: 欧洲的农场主们正在策划一场反对削减农场补贴的大游行。

meaning: n. 场面；情景；景象；事件
example: He photographed a wide range of street scenes.
translation: 他拍下了丰富多彩的街景。

meaning: n. 空间；太空；距离; v. 留间隔
example: How much space is there on each disk?
translation: 每张磁盘有多大容量？

meaning: adj. 仅仅的；只不过的; n. 小湖；池塘
example: She lost the election by a mere 20 votes.
translation: 她仅仅以20票之差落选。

meaning: adj. 昂贵的；花钱的
example: Petrol is becoming more and more expensive.
translation: 汽油越来越贵了。

meaning: n. 卡片；纸牌；明信片; v. 记于卡片上
example: Employees must show their identity cards at the gate.
translation: 雇员在大门口必须出示自己的身份卡。

meaning: adj. 广阔的；巨大的；大量的；巨额的; n. 浩瀚；广阔无垠的空间
example: The refugees come across the border in vast numbers.
translation: 大量难民涌过边境。

meaning: v. 引起；创作
example: The technique was originated by an Italian artist.
translation: 这种技艺由一位意大利艺术家首创。

meaning: v. 欢呼；使高兴；为…加油; n. 欢呼；愉快；心情；令人愉快的事
example: Everybody cheered when the firemen arrived.
translation: 消防员到达时，大家都欢呼起来。

meaning: n. 添加；[数] 加法；增加物
example: This is a fine book; a worthy addition to the series.
translation: 这是一本好书——是对这套丛书有价值的增补。

meaning: n. 目标；靶子; v. 把……作为目标；规定……的指标；瞄准某物
example: There is no target date for completion of the new project.
translation: 这个新的项目何时完工没有预定日期。

meaning: v. 应受，应得
example: What have I done to deserve this?
translation: 我做了什么事，要得到这样的报应？

meaning: n. 宪法；体制；章程；构造；建立，组成；体格
example: The right to speak freely is written into the Constitution of the United States.
translation: 言论自由的权利被写入美国宪法。

meaning: v. 欣赏；感激；领会；鉴别
example: Thanks ever so much for your help, I really appreciate it.
translation: 多谢你的帮助，我真的很感激。

meaning: adv. 因此；结果；所以
example: Most computer users have never received any formal keyboard training. Consequently, their keyboard skills are inefficient.
translation: 大多数的电脑使用者都没有经过正规的键盘操作训练，因此他们的键盘技巧不够熟练。

meaning: v. 合作，配合；协力
example: They agreed to co-operate with Brazil on a programme to protect the rain forests.
translation: 他们同意和巴西合作进行一个保护热带雨林的项目。

meaning: v. 喂养；供给；放牧；抚养（家庭等）；靠…为生; n. 饲料；饲养；（动物或婴儿的）一餐
example: Feed the tomatoes once a week.
translation: 每周给番茄施一次肥。

meaning: adj. 重要的；决定性的；定局的；决断的
example: The conservation of tropical forests is of crucial importance .
translation: 保护热带雨林至关重要。

meaning: n. 主任，主管；导演；人事助理
example: The company is run by a board of directors (= a group of directors ) .
translation: 这家公司由董事会管理。

meaning: n. 长度，长；时间的长短；（语）音长
example: We measured the length and width of the living room.
translation: 我们量了客厅的长和宽。

meaning: v. 成功；继承；继任；兴旺
example: She wanted to be the first woman to climb Mount Qomolangma, and she almost succeeded.
translation: 她本想成为第一位登上珠穆朗玛峰的女性，而且差一点就成功了。

meaning: adj. 流行的，通俗的；受欢迎的；大众的；普及的
example: Hilary was popular at school.
translation: 希拉里在学校里很受欢迎。

meaning: v. 警告，提醒；通知
example: ‘Be careful, the rocks are slippery,’ Alex warned.
translation: “小心，岩石很滑。”亚历克斯提醒说。

meaning: n. 声音；嗓音；发言权；愿望; v. 表达；吐露
example: He recognized her voice instantly.
translation: 他立刻听出了她的声音。

meaning: adj. 漂亮的；可爱的；优美的; adv. 相当地；颇; n. 有吸引力的事物（尤指饰品）；漂亮的人
example: Maria looks much prettier with her hair cut short.
translation: 玛丽亚把头发剪短好看多了。

meaning: adj. 国内的；家庭的；驯养的；一心只管家务的; n. 国货；佣人
example: Unfortunately his domestic life wasn’t very happy.
translation: 不幸的是，他的家庭生活并不幸福。

meaning: adj. 热情的；热心的；狂热的
example: an enthusiastic supporter of reform
translation: 改革的热心支持者

meaning: n. 对手；竞争者; v. 与…竞争；比得上某人; adj. 竞争的
example: This gives the company a competitive advantage over its rivals.
translation: 这使该公司与其对手相比具有一项竞争优势。

meaning: n. （身体或器官内的）室，膛；房间；会所; adj. 室内的；私人的，秘密的; v. 把…关在室内；装填（弹药等）
example: The heart has four chambers.
translation: 心脏有四个腔。

meaning: adj. 电子的; n. 电子电路；电子器件
example: electronic games
translation: 电子游戏

meaning: n. 争论；论战；辩论
example: (= began ) over the use of the chemicals on crops.
translation: 对庄稼施用化学品的做法引起了争论。

meaning: v. 管理；支配；统治；控制
example: The party had been governing for seven months.
translation: 该党执政已经有七个月了。

meaning: v. 补偿，赔偿；抵消
example: Because my left eye is so weak, my right eye has to work harder to compensate.
translation: 因为我左眼视力差，右眼就要辛苦点来弥补一下。

meaning: v. 订阅；捐款；认购；赞成；签署
example: My main reason for subscribing to New Scientist is to keep abreast of advances in science.
translation: 我订阅《新科学家》的主要原因是要跟上科学的进步。

meaning: v. 忍受；默许；宽恕
example: We simply will not tolerate vigilante groups on our streets.
translation: 我们决不容许有自行惩办犯罪的组织出现在我们的街头。

meaning: adj. 年度的；每年的; n. 年刊，年鉴；一年生植物
example: The school trip has become an annual event.
translation: 学校组织的旅行成了一年一度的活动。

meaning: n. 遗憾；抱歉；悲叹; v. 后悔；惋惜；哀悼
example: It is with great regret that I must decline your offer.
translation: 很遗憾，我不得不谢绝你的好意。

meaning: adj. [经] 疲软的；虚弱的；无力的；不牢固的
example: The illness left her feeling weak.
translation: 疾病使她感到身体虚弱。

meaning: v. 转换；用鞭子等抽打; n. 开关；转换；鞭子
example: The terrorists will switch tactics .
translation: 恐怖分子会改变战术。

meaning: n. 个性；品格；名人
example: Despite their different personalities, they became the best of friends.
translation: 尽管个性不同，他们还是成了最好的朋友。

meaning: n. 仆人，佣人；公务员；雇工
example: Many young girls became domestic servants .
translation: 许多年轻姑娘成了家仆。

meaning: adj. 广泛的；大量的；广阔的
example: The house stands in extensive grounds.
translation: 这栋房子占地面积很大。

meaning: adj. 安全的；可靠的；平安的; n. 保险箱；冷藏室；纱橱
example: She doesn’t feel safe in the house on her own.
translation: 她独自一人在家感到不安全。

meaning: n. 债务；借款；罪过
example: He had enough money to pay off his outstanding debts.
translation: 他有足够的钱偿还亏欠的债务。

meaning: v. 俘获；夺得；捕捉，拍摄,录制; n. 捕获；战利品，俘虏
example: Government troops have succeeded in capturing the rebel leader.
translation: 政府军已经成功抓获叛乱分子的头目。

meaning: n. [计] 程序；日常工作；例行公事; adj. 日常的；例行的
example: John’s departure had upset their daily routine .
translation: 约翰的离去打乱了他们的日常生活。

meaning: n. 要求；必要条件；必需品
example: The refugees’ main requirements are food and shelter.
translation: 难民的主要需求是食物和住所。

meaning: adj. 有希望的，有前途的; v. 许诺，答应（promise的现在分词形式）
example: a promising career in law
translation: 很有前途的法律职业

meaning: n. 延长；延期；扩大；伸展；电话分机
example: a loft extension
translation: 增建的阁楼

meaning: n. 特性，特点；品质；少许
example: The study found that some alcoholics had clear personality traits showing up early in childhood.
translation: 这项研究发现一些酗酒者早在孩童时就表现出明显的个性特征。

meaning: v. 庆祝；举行；赞美；祝贺；宣告
example: It’s Dad’s birthday and we’re going out for a meal to celebrate.
translation: 今天是爸爸的生日，我们打算出去吃饭庆祝一下。

meaning: n. 议程；日常工作事项；日程表
example: The Republicans have stuck to their conservative agenda.
translation: 共和党人坚持自己的保守议题。

meaning: adj. 迅速的，急促的；飞快的；险峻的; n. 急流；高速交通工具，高速交通网
example: The patient made a rapid recovery.
translation: 病人迅速康复。

meaning: adj. 敌对的，敌方的；怀敌意的; n. 敌对
example: Southampton fans gave their former coach a hostile reception .
translation: 南安普敦队的球迷对球队的前任教练很不友善。

meaning: adj. 热的；辣的；热情的；激动的；紧迫的; adv. 热；紧迫地; v. 变热
example: a hot curry
translation: 一种辛辣的咖喱

meaning: adj. 以前的；早先的；过早的; adv. 在先；在…以前
example: She has a teenage daughter from a previous marriage.
translation: 她有个出自前一次婚姻的十几岁的女儿。

meaning: adj. 模糊不清的；引起歧义的
example: The language in the Minister’s statement is highly ambiguous.
translation: 部长的声明措辞很含糊。

meaning: v. 承认；答谢；报偿；告知已收到
example: The family acknowledge the need for change.
translation: 全家人都承认需要改变一下。

meaning: n. 边缘；利润，余裕；页边的空白; v. 加边于；加旁注于
example: Someone had scribbled a note in the margin .
translation: 有人在页边写了条批注。

meaning: adj. 深厚的；意义深远的；渊博的
example: a profound sense of guilt
translation: 强烈的内疚感

meaning: adj. 适当的；本身的；特有的；正派的; adv. 完全地
example: Everything was in its proper place (= where it should be ) .
translation: 每样东西都放在恰当的位置。

meaning: n. 战略，策略
example: the government’s long-term economic strategy
translation: 政府的长期经济策略

meaning: n. 秘密；秘诀；机密; adj. 秘密的；机密的
example: I can’t tell you. It’s a secret .
translation: 我不能告诉你，这是个秘密。

meaning: v. 加重；使恶化；激怒
example: Their money problems were further aggravated by a rise in interest rates.
translation: 由于利率上调，他们的财务问题更加严重。

meaning: adj. 肥的，胖的；油腻的；丰满的; n. 脂肪，肥肉; v. 养肥；在…中加入脂肪
example: Are you suggesting I’m too fat?
translation: 你是不是在说我太胖了？

meaning: n. 显示；炫耀; v. 显示；表现；陈列; adj. 展览的；陈列用的
example: This time the display flashed a red warning signal.
translation: 这次显示器上闪烁着红色的警报信号。

meaning: v. 倾斜；倚靠；倾向；依赖; adj. 瘦的；贫乏的，歉收的; n. 瘦肉；倾斜；倾斜度
example: trees leaning in the wind
translation: 在风中东倒西歪的树木

meaning: v. 敢于; n. 企业；风险；冒险
example: ...a Russian-American joint venture.
translation: …一个俄美合资的风险项目。

meaning: n. [化学] 载体；运送者；带菌者；货架
example: carriers of the lung disease, TB
translation: 肺结核病菌的携带者

meaning: adv. 照字面地；逐字地；不夸张地；正确地；简直
example: Dad was literally blazing with anger.
translation: 爸爸简直是火冒三丈。

meaning: v. 逃避；规避；逃脱
example: You can’t go on evading your responsibilities in this way.
translation: 你不能这样继续逃避责任。

meaning: v. 通讯，传达；相通；交流；感染
example: We communicated mostly by e-mail.
translation: 我们主要是用电子邮件沟通。

meaning: v. 打，打击；罢工；敲，敲击；抓；打动；穿透; n. 罢工；打击；殴打
example: She fell heavily, striking her head against the side of the boat.
translation: 她重重地摔倒，头撞在船舷上。

meaning: v. 改变，更改
example: Her face hadn’t altered much over the years.
translation: 过了这么多年，她的容貌并没有多大改变。

meaning: v. 出现；上升；起立
example: A crisis has arisen in the Foreign Office.
translation: 外交部出现了危机。

meaning: n. 青年；青春；年轻；青少年时期
example: a gang of youths
translation: 一伙少年

meaning: adj. 著名的；极好的，非常令人满意的
example: Many famous people have stayed in the hotel.
translation: 许多名人都曾下榻这家酒店。

meaning: adj. 不寻常的；与众不同的；不平常的
example: It’s unusual for Dave to be late.
translation: 戴夫迟到是很少见的。

meaning: adj. 历史的；史学的；基于史实的
example: It is important to look at the novel in its historical context .
translation: 在历史背景下看待这部小说很重要。

meaning: adj. 随便的；非正式的；临时的；偶然的; n. 便装；临时工人；待命士兵
example: Jean felt more comfortable in casual clothes .
translation: 琼穿上便服感到更舒服。

meaning: adj. 侵略性的；好斗的；有进取心的；有闯劲的
example: Jim’s voice became aggressive.
translation: 吉姆的声音凶了起来。

meaning: v. 修正；复习；校订; n. 修订；校订
example: The college has revised its plans because of local objections.
translation: 由于地方上的反对，学院已经修改了计划。

meaning: n. 管理；行政；实施；行政机构
example: We’re looking for someone with experience in administration.
translation: 我们正在寻找一个有管理经验的人。

meaning: adj. 基本的，根本的; n. 基本原理；基本原则
example: We have to tackle the fundamental cause of the problem.
translation: 我们必须解决问题的根本原因。

meaning: adj. 相当大的；重要的，值得考虑的
example: Michael has already spent considerable time in Barcelona.
translation: 迈克尔在巴塞罗那已经待了相当长的时间了。

meaning: n. 风格；时尚；类型；字体; v. 设计；称呼；使合潮流
example: an attempt to use Japanese management style in a European business
translation: 将日本的管理方式用于欧洲企业的尝试

meaning: n. 操作；经营；[外科] 手术；[数][计] 运算
example: Many small businesses fail in the first year of operation.
translation: 许多小企业在经营的第一年就倒闭了。

meaning: adj. 灵活的；柔韧的；易弯曲的
example: We can be flexible about your starting date.
translation: 你具体从哪天开始，我们可以灵活一点。

meaning: n. 阶段；舞台；戏剧；驿站; v. 举行；上演；筹划
example: We’re getting to the stage where we hardly ever go out together.
translation: 我们快要到几乎不一起外出的地步了。

meaning: n. 诱惑；饵；诱惑物; v. 诱惑；引诱
example: The excitement of hunting big game in Africa has been a lure to Europeans for 200 years.
translation: 在非洲捕捉大型猎物所带来的刺激，200年来一直吸引着欧洲人。

meaning: v. 交往；结交; n. 同事，伙伴；关联的事物; adj. 副的；联合的
example: I don’t like these layabouts you’re associating with.
translation: 我不喜欢你结交的这些游手好闲的人。

meaning: n. 候选人，候补者；应试者
example: a presidential candidate
translation: 总统候选人

meaning: adj. 被动的，消极的；被动语态的; n. 被动语态
example: Kathy seems to take a very passive role in the relationship.
translation: 凯茜在这一关系中似乎扮演着十分被动的角色。

meaning: n. 冲动；[电子] 脉冲；刺激；神经冲动；推动力; v. 推动
example: The eye converts light signals to nerve impulses.
translation: 眼睛把光信号转变成神经冲动。

meaning: n. 文件；档案；文件夹；锉刀; v. 提出；锉；琢磨；把…归档
example: We will keep your details on file (= store them for later use ) .
translation: 我们将把你的详细资料存档。

meaning: n. 轻视，蔑视；耻辱
example: The public is treated with contempt by broadcasters.
translation: 公众受到了节目主持人的轻蔑对待。

meaning: n. 追求；寻找; v. 追求；寻找
example: They journeyed to the distant Molucca islands in quest of spices.
translation: 他们远赴摩鹿加群岛寻找香料。

meaning: n. [计] 主机；主人；主持人；许多; v. 主持；当主人招待
example: Our host greeted us at the door.
translation: 主人在门口迎接我们。

meaning: v. 察觉，感觉；理解；认知
example: That morning, he perceived a change in Franca’s mood.
translation: 那天早上，他注意到弗兰卡情绪的变化。

meaning: n. 动机，目的；主题; adj. 发动的；成为动机的; v. 使产生动机，激起
example: What do you suppose the killer’s motive was?
translation: 你认为凶手的动机是什么？

meaning: n. 杯子；奖杯；酒杯; v. 使成杯状；为…拔火罐
example: Mathew picked up the cup and sipped his coffee.
translation: 马修拿起杯子抿了口咖啡。

meaning: adj. 足够的；充分的
example: We can only prosecute if there is sufficient evidence.
translation: 有了足够的证据，我们才能提出起诉。

meaning: v. 回答；作出反应；承担责任; n. 应答；唱和
example: They are likely to respond positively to the president's request for aid.
translation: 他们有可能积极地回应该总统的援助请求。

meaning: n. 标题；（足球）头球；信头; v. 用头顶（head的ing形式）
example: chapter headings
translation: 章节标题

meaning: v. 解决；定居；沉淀；下陷; n. 有背长椅
example: We hope the factions will be able to settle their differences (= agree to stop arguing ) by peaceful means.
translation: 我们希望各派系能以和平方式解决分歧。

meaning: n. 变化；[生物] 变异，变种
example: Most of his poems are variations on the theme of love.
translation: 他的大部分诗作都是有关爱情主题的形式不同的作品。

meaning: n. 仪表板；嵌板；座谈小组，全体陪审员; v. 嵌镶板
example: He assembled a panel of scholars to advise him.
translation: 他集结了一个学者小组为他出谋划策。

meaning: adj. 微小的；很少的
example: The earrings were tiny.
translation: 耳环很小。

meaning: adj. 谨慎的；精明的；节俭的
example: prudent house buyers
translation: 谨慎的购房者

meaning: n. 批准；认可；赞成
example: The president has already given his approval to the plan.
translation: 总统已经批准了这个计划。

meaning: adj. 过多的，极度的；过分的
example: $15 for two beers seems a little excessive.
translation: 两杯啤酒要15美元，似乎有点过分。

meaning: adj. 谦虚的，谦逊的；适度的；端庄的；羞怯的
example: You’re too modest! You’ve been a huge help to us.
translation: 你太谦虚了！你帮了我们大忙呢。

meaning: n. 挫折；退步；逆流
example: The team’s hopes of playing in Europe suffered a setback last night.
translation: 球队赴欧洲参加比赛的希望昨晚遇到了阻碍。

meaning: v. 邀请，招待；招致; n. 邀请
example: I’m afraid I wasn’t invited.
translation: 恐怕我没有受到邀请。

meaning: v. 领先，在…之前；优于，高于
example: Lunch will be preceded by a short speech from the chairman.
translation: 午餐开始之前主席会发表一段简短的讲话。

meaning: adj. 仔细的，小心的
example: Be careful - the floor’s slippery.
translation: 小心——地板很滑。

meaning: adj. 直的；连续的；笔直的；正直的；整齐的；异性恋的; adv. 直接地；不断地；立即；坦率地; n. 直；直线；直男，直女，异性恋者
example: Try to keep your legs straight.
translation: 尽量把腿伸直。

meaning: n. 原理，原则；主义，道义；本质，本义；根源，源泉
example: The general principle is that education should be available to all children up to the age of 16.
translation: 总的原则是，16 岁以下儿童都应该能接受教育。

meaning: v. 解决；解答；溶解
example: Charlie thinks money will solve all his problems.
translation: 查理认为钱能解决他所有的问题。

meaning: v. 解散；解雇；开除；让离开；不予理会、不予考虑
example: The government has dismissed criticisms that the country’s health policy is a mess.
translation: 有人认为国家医疗政策一塌糊涂，政府对这种批评持否认态度。

meaning: n. 瑕疵，缺点；一阵狂风；短暂的风暴；裂缝，裂纹; v. 使生裂缝，使有裂纹；使无效；使有缺陷
example: A design flaw (= a mistake or weakness in the way something was made ) caused the engine to explode.
translation: 一个设计缺陷导致了引擎爆炸。

meaning: v. 延伸；扩大；推广；伸出；给予；使竭尽全力；对…估价
example: Management have agreed to extend the deadline.
translation: 管理层已同意延长最后期限。

meaning: v. 吸收；吸引；承受；理解；使…全神贯注
example: Plants absorb nutrients from the soil.
translation: 植物从土壤中吸收养分。

meaning: adj. 奇怪的；陌生的；外行的; adv. 奇怪地；陌生地，冷淡地
example: Does Geoff’s behaviour seem strange to you?
translation: 你觉得杰夫的行为反常吗？

meaning: n. 损失，代价；消费；开支; v. 向…收取费用; v. 被花掉
example: He's bought a big TV at vast expense so that everyone can see properly.
translation: 他花了很多钱买了台大电视，这样人人都可以看清楚了。

meaning: adj. 供选择的；选择性的；交替的; n. 二中择一；供替代的选择
example: ...alternative health care.
translation: …替代性保健。

meaning: v. 破坏；消灭；毁坏
example: companies that are polluting and destroying the environment
translation: 污染和破坏环境的公司

meaning: n. 幻觉，错觉；错误的观念或信仰
example: She was under no illusion that he loved her.
translation: 她不再幻想他爱她了。

meaning: n. 移动；变化；手段；轮班; v. 移动；转变；转换
example: A shift system has been introduced.
translation: 实行了轮班工作制。

meaning: v. 诱惑；引起；冒…的风险；使感兴趣
example: If you leave valuables in your car it will tempt thieves.
translation: 如果把贵重物品留在车上，会招来小偷的。

meaning: v. 促进；增加；支援; n. 推动；帮助；宣扬
example: The new resort area has boosted tourism.
translation: 新的度假区促进了旅游业的发展。

meaning: n. 演讲者；扬声器；说话者；说某种语言的人
example: The keynote speaker (= main or most important speaker ) was Robert Venturi, the architect.
translation: 主要发言人是建筑师罗伯特·文图里。

meaning: adj. 集体的；共同的；集合的；集体主义的; n. 集团；集合体；集合名词
example: a collective decision made by all board members
translation: 董事会所有成员作出的集体决定

meaning: n. 演讲；讲话；[语] 语音；演说
example: He has to make a lot of after-dinner speeches .
translation: 他经常要发表席后演说。

meaning: adj. 显性的；占优势的；支配的，统治的; n. 显性
example: The dominant male gorilla is the largest in the group.
translation: 领头的公猩猩是这群大猩猩中体形最大的一个。

meaning: n. 行，排；划船；街道；吵闹; v. 划船；使……成排
example: (= many rows ) of shelves stacked with books
translation: 一排又一排堆满书的架子

meaning: n. 哲学；哲理；人生观
example: Emma studies philosophy at university.
translation: 埃玛在大学攻读哲学。

meaning: v. 操纵；操作；巧妙地处理；篡改
example: He was one of those men who manipulated people.
translation: 他是那种要摆布别人的人。

meaning: v. 源于；得自；获得
example: Mr. Ying is one of those happy people who derive pleasure from helping others.
translation: 英先生是那种助人为乐的快活人。

meaning: n. 笑；引人发笑的事或人; v. 笑
example: He gave a short laugh.
translation: 他笑了一声。

meaning: v. 授予…学位；分等级；标上刻度; n. 研究生；毕业生; adj. 毕业的；研究生的
example: As an actress she has graduated from small roles to more substantial parts.
translation: 作为演员，她从配角演起，慢慢地开始出演比较重要的角色。

meaning: n. 柜台；对立面；计数器；（某些棋盘游戏的）筹码; v. 反击，还击；反向移动，对着干；反驳，回答; adj. 相反的; adv. 反方向地；背道而驰地

translation: 他在想柜台后面的那个女孩是否认出了他。

meaning: adj. 民主的；民主政治的；大众的

meaning: adj. 能生产的；生产的，生产性的；多产的；富有成效的
example: Most of us are more productive in the morning.
translation: 我们大多数人在早上更有效率。

meaning: v. 克服；胜过

translation: 他努力克服自己的羞怯。

meaning: v. 通知；为…做广告；使突出

meaning: n. 委员会；会议；理事会；地方议会；顾问班子

meaning: v. 使需要，必需；承担；遗传给；蕴含; n. 引起；需要；继承

translation: 使用新的计算机系统需要大量的再培训。

meaning: n. 儿子；孩子（对年轻人的称呼）；男性后裔

translation: 她的儿子肖恩出生于 1983 年。

meaning: n. 民主，民主主义；民主政治

translation: 16年军人统治后民主制度的恢复

meaning: n. 学院；研究院；学会；专科院校

translation: 美国艺术和文学学会

meaning: v. 培养；树立；栽种; adv. 向后；在后面; adj. 后方的；后面的；背面的; n. 后面；屁股；后方部队

translation: 她抚养大了16个孩子，6个她自己的，10个她丈夫的。

meaning: n. 专家；专门医师; adj. 专家的；专业的

meaning: n. 承认；入场费；进入许可；坦白；录用
example: Reese, by his own admission , lacks the necessary experience.
translation: 里斯自己也承认缺乏必要的经验。

meaning: adj. 变量的；可变的；易变的，多变的；变异的，[生物] 畸变的; n. [数] 变量；可变物，可变因素
example: Expect variable cloudiness and fog tomorrow.
translation: 预计明天多云有雾，天气多变。

meaning: v. 迫使；强制；赐，施恩惠；责成；义务
example: The storm got worse and worse. Finally, I was obliged to abandon the car and continue on foot.
translation: 暴风雨越来越猛烈。最终，我被迫弃车徒步前行。

meaning: n. 水果；产物; v. 结果实
example: Try to eat plenty of fresh fruit .
translation: 尽量多吃新鲜水果。

meaning: adj. 家庭的；日常的；王室的; n. 全家人，一家人；(包括佣工在内的)家庭，户
example: household chores
translation: 家务杂活

meaning: adj. 明智的；聪明的；博学的; v. 使知道；教导
example: I don’t think that would be a very wise move (= not be a sensible thing to do ).
translation: 我认为那样做不是很明智。

meaning: v. 钉；使固定；揭露; n. [解剖] 指甲；钉子

translation: 弗兰克放下第一块木板，把它钉到位。

meaning: v. 区分；辨别；使杰出，使表现突出

translation: 光线太暗，我什么也看不清。

meaning: n. 海湾；狗吠声; v. 向…吠叫

translation: 一只狗忽然嚎叫起来，对月长嗥。

meaning: n. 殖民地；移民队；种群；动物栖息地

translation: 阿尔及利亚以前是法国的殖民地。

meaning: n. 动物，生物；人；创造物

translation: 海洋中所有的生物

meaning: n. 核心；伤口的嫩肉; adj. 快的；迅速的，敏捷的；灵敏的; adv. 迅速地，快

translation: 她的指甲都咬到肉里了。

meaning: v. 使…完整；使…成整体；求…的积分；表示…的总和; adj. 整合的；完全的; n. 一体化；集成体

translation: 美国海军陆战队是最后合并的部队。

meaning: n. 金，黄金；金色；金币; adj. 金的，金制的；金色的

translation: 她披金戴银地来参加派对。

meaning: adv. 不幸地
example: Unfortunately, you were out when we called.
translation: 很遗憾，我们来的时候你出去了。

meaning: v. 划分；除；分开；使产生分歧; n. [地理] 分水岭，分水线

translation: 锻炼对身体的好处可以分成3个方面。

meaning: n. 轮廓；大纲；概要；略图; v. 概述；略述；描画…轮廓

translation: 研究计划梗概

meaning: adj. 极端的；极度的；偏激的；尽头的; n. 极端；末端；最大程度；极端的事物

translation: 许多农村地区仍处于赤贫状态。

meaning: n. 绘画；油画；着色; v. 绘画（paint的ing形式）；涂色于

translation: 你帮我把这幅画挂起来好吗？

meaning: v. 打；打败; n. 拍子；敲击；有规律的一连串敲打; adj. 筋疲力尽的；疲惫不堪的
example: Brazil were beaten 2–1.
translation: 巴西队以1比2告负。

meaning: v. 围绕；包围; n. 围绕物; adj. 环绕立体声的

translation: 他怒视着围住帐篷的那些人。

meaning: adj. 深思的；体贴的；关切的

meaning: n. 资源，财力；办法；智谋

meaning: n. [计] 局部；当地居民；本地新闻; adj. 当地的；局部的；地方性的；乡土的

translation: 我们请一位当地人推荐一家餐馆。

meaning: n. 所有权；物主身份

translation: 房价在不断上涨。

meaning: n. 药方；指示；惯例; adj. 凭处方方可购买的

translation: 我们正努力降低处方药的价格。

meaning: n. 癌症；恶性肿瘤

translation: 现在许多癌症可以治愈。

meaning: v. 放松，休息；松懈，松弛；变从容；休养

translation: 我只想坐下来休息一下。

meaning: n. 高兴; v. 高兴
example: Throughout the house, the views are a constant source of surprise and delight.
translation: 整个房子，目之所及不停带来惊奇和欣喜。

meaning: n. 愤怒，愤慨；暴行；侮辱; v. 凌辱，强奸；对…施暴行；激起愤怒

translation: 陪审团的裁决引发了愤慨。

meaning: v. 折叠；合拢；抱住；笼罩; n. 折痕；信徒；羊栏

translation: 沿虚线将纸折起来。

meaning: n. 数组，阵列；排列，列阵；大批，一系列；衣服; v. 排列，部署；打扮

translation: 一大堆眼花缭乱的选择

meaning: adj. 多余的；不必要的；奢侈的
example: a modern building with no superfluous decoration
translation: 一栋没有多余装饰的现代建筑

meaning: n. 房间；空间；余地；机会；房间里所有的人; v. 为…提供住处；租房，合住；投宿，住宿；留…住宿

translation: 我四下看了看房间。

meaning: adj. 平等的；相等的；胜任的; v. 等于；比得上; n. 对手；匹敌；同辈；相等的事物

translation: 我们的宪法规定人人平等。

meaning: n. 获得物，获得；收购

translation: 语言的习得

meaning: n. 反馈；成果，资料；回复

translation: 我怎样才能提出反馈意见又不会得罪人呢？

meaning: v. 钦佩；赞美

translation: 我十分佩服她独力把那些孩子抚养大。

meaning: v. 承认；准许进入；可容纳

translation: “行了，也许我是有点害怕。”珍妮承认道。

meaning: adj. 语言的；语言学的

translation: 儿童的语言发展

meaning: n. 工程师；工兵；火车司机; v. 设计；策划；精明地处理

translation: 他接受过土木工程师培训。

meaning: n. 表面；表层；外观; adj. 表面的，肤浅的; v. 浮出水面

translation: 地球表面将近 10% 被冰层覆盖。

meaning: n. 气泡，泡沫，泡状物；透明圆形罩，圆形顶; v. 沸腾，冒泡；发出气泡声

translation: 水烧开时，水面会冒泡泡。

meaning: n. 立法；法律

translation: 这是一条非常重要的法规。

meaning: n. 信心；信任；秘密; adj. （美）诈骗的；骗得信任的

translation: 我觉得自己干得不错，自信心就开始增加了。

meaning: v. 属于，应归入；居住；适宜；应被放置

translation: 这座房子属于她家已有三四代了。

meaning: n. 餐馆；[经] 饭店

translation: 他带她到一家豪华餐厅吃了一顿有五道菜的晚餐。

meaning: n. 女士，小姐，年轻未婚女子

translation: 我想约一下泰勒小姐。

meaning: adj. 全部的；完全的；整个的; v. 总数达; n. 总数，合计

translation: 他一头雾水地望着她。

meaning: n. 味道；品味；审美; v. 尝；体验

translation: 这药略带苦味。

translation: 这家制鞋厂是本地区最大的雇主。

meaning: n. 假定；设想；担任；采取

translation: 你会做出不以你能报道的任何事实为依据的一种假设。

meaning: v. 驱使；激怒；煽动；惹起

translation: 那部小说在美国引发了激烈的争论。

translation: 凯蒂还醒着，坐得笔直，眼睛盯着电视。

meaning: n. 退休金，抚恤金；津贴；膳宿费; v. 发给养老金或抚恤金

translation: 从多少岁可以开始领取养老金？

meaning: v. 计算；认为; n. 计数；计算；伯爵

translation: 我们有两千多人，不包括工作人员在内。

meaning: v. 运转；动手术；起作用

translation: 医生不得不开刀取出子弹。

meaning: n. 愤怒；狂暴，肆虐；情绪激动; v. 大怒，发怒；流行，风行

translation: 卡罗尔气得呜呜哭，被送往医院。

meaning: v. 投诉；发牢骚；诉说

translation: 由于这个地区的交通流量有所增加，居民都在抱怨。

meaning: v. 控制；使掌握；持有；迷住；拥有，具备

translation: 不同的工人拥有不同技能。

meaning: v. 嫁；娶；与……结婚

translation: 他在1925年娶了贝亚。

meaning: v. 通知；告诉；报告

translation: 他们决定通知警察。

meaning: v. 欠；感激；应给予；应该把……归功于

translation: 我该付你多少钱？

meaning: n. 属，种；种族，人种；家庭，门第; v. 使参加比赛；和…竞赛；使急走，使全速行进

translation: 该校欢迎各种族的学生就读。

meaning: adj. 积极的；[数] 正的，[医][化学] 阳性的；确定的，肯定的；实际的，真实的；绝对的; n. 正数；[摄] 正片

translation: 至少这个情况也产生了一些积极的东西。

meaning: n. 好奇，好奇心；珍品，古董，古玩

translation: 我打开包裹只是为了满足我的好奇心。

meaning: adj. 完美的；最好的；精通的; v. 使完美；使熟练; n. 完成式
example: His English was perfect.
translation: 他的英语很地道。

meaning: v. 假定；设想；承担；采取

translation: 我想我们几乎可以肯定，利率很快会再次上调。

meaning: adj. 已婚的，有配偶的；婚姻的，夫妇的；密切结合的; n. 已婚者; v. 结婚，与…结婚（marry的过去式）

translation: 你是已婚还是单身？

meaning: v. 保证，确保；使安全

translation: 确保骑车人安全的设施

meaning: adj. 普遍的，广泛的；分布广的

translation: 化学品在农业中的广泛使用

meaning: v. 躺下；产卵；搁放；放置；铺放；涂，敷; adj. 世俗的；外行的；没有经验的; n. 位置；短诗；花纹方向；叙事诗；性伙伴

translation: 他把一只手搭在我的肩上。

meaning: n. 一千；一千个；许许多多; adj. 成千的；无数的

translation: 将近1,000英里的旅程

meaning: adj. 故意的；深思熟虑的；从容的; v. 仔细考虑；商议

translation: 对他的袭击完全是有预谋的。

meaning: adj. 野生的；野蛮的；狂热的；荒凉的; n. 荒野; adv. 疯狂地；胡乱地
example: {"COLLOINEXA":["wild animals"]}
translation: 野生动物

meaning: v. 控制；精通；征服; n. 硕士；主人；大师；教师; adj. 主人的；主要的；熟练的

translation: 我一直学不会穿高跟鞋走路。

meaning: v. 驱使；强迫；束缚

translation: 贫瘠的土地限制了农作物的产量。

meaning: n. 委员会；佣金；犯；委任；委任状; v. 委任；使服役；委托制作
example: The Government set up a commission to investigate allegations of police violence.
translation: 政府成立了一个委员会调查对警察施暴行为的指控。

meaning: n. 持有人；所有人；固定器；（台、架等）支持物
example: Season-ticket holders are furious at the rise in rail fares.
translation: 买季票的人对火车票价上涨极为愤怒。

meaning: v. 抑制；镇压；废止
example: The uprising was ruthlessly suppressed.
translation: 起义受到了残酷的镇压。

meaning: n. 期待；预期；指望

translation: 他唤起了大家的希望，但接着只是帮助了几个人。

meaning: n. 音乐家

translation: 有天赋的年轻音乐家

meaning: adj. 巨大的；庞大的；无限的
example: Your room’s huge compared to mine.
translation: 你的房间跟我的比很大。

meaning: v. 集中；浓缩；全神贯注；聚集; n. 浓缩，精选；浓缩液
example: Adrian was finding it difficult to concentrate.
translation: 阿德里安觉得自己很难集中注意力。

meaning: n. 失业；失业率；失业人数

translation: 高失业率城镇

meaning: n. 对；夫妇；数个; v. 结合；成婚

translation: 一对新婚夫妇

meaning: adj. 弥漫的；散开的; v. 扩散；传播；漫射
example: The organization is large and diffuse.
translation: 这个组织规模大、分布广。

meaning: adj. 永久的，永恒的；不变的; n. 烫发（等于permanent wave）
example: He gave up a permanent job in order to freelance.
translation: 他放弃了固定工作，为的是当一名自由职业者。

meaning: v. 监督，管理；指导
example: Griffiths closely supervised the research.
translation: 格里菲思密切指导该项研究。

meaning: n. 细胞；电池；蜂房的巢室；单人小室; v. 住在牢房或小室中

translation: 胚胎通过细胞分裂而成长。

meaning: v. 回答；[法] 答辩；回击; n. 回答；[法] 答辩

translation: 我问克莱夫到哪儿去，但他没有回答。

meaning: adj. 工艺的，科技的；技术上的；专门的
example: Our staff will be available to give you technical support .
translation: 有我们的员工向你提供技术支持。

meaning: n. 交易；便宜货；契约; v. 讨价还价；议价；(谈价钱后)卖
example: There are no bargains in the clothes shops at the moment.
translation: 这阵子服装店里没有什么便宜货。

meaning: n. 倾向，趋势；癖好

example: In desperation, Mrs. Jones submitted to an operation on her right knee to relieve the pain.
translation: 绝望中，琼斯夫人不得已接受了一次她右膝的手术以减轻疼痛。

meaning: n. 印象；效果，影响；压痕，印记；感想；曝光（衡量广告被显示的次数。打开一个带有该广告的网页，则该广告的impression 次数增加一次）
example: When we looked around the school we got a very good impression.
translation: 我们参观了学校，对它的印象很好。

meaning: n. 鼓舞，刺激；马刺；山坡; v. 骑马疾驰；给予刺激
example: The crowd’s reaction only acted as a spur.
translation: 人群的反应不过起了刺激作用。

meaning: v. 反应；影响；反抗；起反作用
example: He reacted angrily to the suggestion that he had lied.
translation: 说他撒谎，他非常生气。

meaning: v. 例证；例示
example: All these recipes exemplify my cooking: healthy, delicious and quick.
translation: 所有这些食谱例证了我的饭菜：健康、美味、快捷。

meaning: v. 准备；使适合；装备；起草
example: The prosecution wanted more time to prepare their case.
translation: 原告想要有更多的时间来准备诉讼。

meaning: n. 接触，联系; v. 使接触，联系
example: The town is cut off from contact with the outside world.
translation: 小镇与外界的联系被切断了。

meaning: v. 使依附；贴上；系上；使依恋
example: We attach labels to things before we file them away.
translation: 我们在把东西归档前先给它们贴上标签。

meaning: n. 一步；步速；步伐；速度; v. 踱步；缓慢而行
example: He quickened his pace , longing to be home.
translation: 他加快步伐，盼望着早点回到家中。

meaning: adj. 神经的；紧张不安的；强健有力的
example: I wish you’d stop looking at me like that. You’re making me nervous.
translation: 我希望你不要再那样看着我了，你让我紧张。

meaning: n. 费用；酬金；小费; v. 付费给……
example: You can use the gym and pool for a fee of £35 a month.
translation: 月付35英镑，即可使用健身房和游泳池。

meaning: v. 猜测；认为；推测；猜中; n. 猜测；推测
example: I’d say he’s around 50, but I’m only guessing.
translation: 我想他50岁左右，不过也只是猜测。

meaning: adj. 不情愿的；勉强的；顽抗的
example: She gave a reluctant smile.
translation: 她勉强笑了笑。

meaning: n. 叶子；（书籍等的）一张；扇页; v. 生叶；翻书页
example: a flowering bush with large shiny leaves
translation: 叶子大而油亮的开花灌木

meaning: n. 外科；外科手术；手术室；诊疗室
example: Dr. Hanson is in surgery.
translation: 汉森医生在手术室。

meaning: n. 人事部门；全体人员; adj. 人员的；有关人事的
example: A copy should then be sent to Personnel for our files.
translation: 然后必须送一份到人事部供我们存档。

meaning: v. 煽动；刺激；吹拂; n. 迷；风扇；爱好者
example: Her resistance only fanned his desire.
translation: 她的反抗反而激起了他的欲望。

meaning: adj. 微妙的；精美的，雅致的；柔和的；易碎的；纤弱的；清淡可口的
example: There’s something I have to speak to you about – it’s a delicate matter .
translation: 我有件事要跟你讲——是一件需要谨慎处理的事。

meaning: n. 城堡；象棋中的车; v. 置…于城堡中；筑城堡防御
example: Edinburgh Castle
translation: 爱丁堡城堡

meaning: n. （批评判断的）标准；准则；规范；准据
example: the criteria we use to select candidates
translation: 我们挑选候选人的标准

meaning: n. 浓度；集中；浓缩；专心；集合
example: She needed all her powers of concentration to stop herself from slipping on the icy road.
translation: 她需要集中全部注意力才能不让自己在结冰的路上滑倒。

meaning: adj. 昏暗的，朦胧的；晦涩的，不清楚的；隐蔽的；不著名的，无名的; v. 使…模糊不清，掩盖；隐藏；使难理解; n. 某种模糊的或不清楚的东西
example: The details of his life remain obscure.
translation: 他的生平不详。

meaning: v. 公然反对；抓…的胡须; n. 胡须；颌毛
example: He's decided to grow a beard.
translation: 他已经决定蓄胡须。

meaning: n. 感情，情绪；情操；观点；多愁善感
example: Similar sentiments were expressed by many politicians.
translation: 许多政治家都表达了相同的观点。

meaning: adj. 综合的；广泛的；有理解力的; n. 综合学校；专业综合测验
example: We offer our customers a comprehensive range of financial products.
translation: 我们为客户提供全面的金融产品。

meaning: n. 娱乐，消遣
example: Reading was her favourite pastime.
translation: 阅读是她最喜爱的消遣方式。

meaning: adj. 怀孕的；富有意义的
example: I knew right away that I was pregnant.
translation: 我立即明白我怀孕了。

meaning: v. 表现；（机器等）运转；举止端正；（事物）起某种作用
example: She behaved in a very responsible way .
translation: 她表现得很有责任心。

meaning: adj. 含蓄的；暗示的；盲从的
example: ...an implicit warning to the Moroccans not to continue or repeat the military actions they began a week ago.
translation: …叫摩洛哥人不要继续或重复一周前开始的军事行动的含蓄警告。

meaning: v. 执行；完成；演奏
example: Surgeons performed an emergency operation.
translation: 外科医生做了一个急诊手术。

meaning: n. 瓷器; adj. 瓷制的
example: china teacups
translation: 瓷茶杯

meaning: v. 复兴；复活；苏醒；恢复精神
example: Local people have decided to revive this centuries-old tradition.
translation: 当地人决定复兴这一延续了数个世纪的传统。

meaning: adj. 宝贵的；珍贵的；矫揉造作的
example: planes delivering precious supplies of medicine and food
translation: 运送药品、食品等宝贵物资的飞机

meaning: n. 朝圣者；漫游者；（美）最初的移民; v. 去朝圣；漫游
example: pilgrims visiting a holy shrine
translation: 祭拜圣庙的朝圣者

meaning: adv. 同样地；也
example: Nanny put on a shawl and told the girls to do likewise.
translation: 南妮披上披肩，并叫女孩们也这样做。

meaning: n. 奖品；奖赏；战利品; v. 珍视；捕获；估价; adj. 获奖的
example: In this month’s competition you could win a prize worth £3,000.
translation: 在本月的竞赛中您可以赢得价值3,000英镑的奖品。

meaning: adj. 严格的；绝对的；精确的；详细的
example: a strict teacher
translation: 严格的老师

meaning: v. 提升；举起；振奋情绪等；提升…的职位
example: Language has elevated humans above the other animals.
translation: 语言使人类高于其他动物。

meaning: n. 英寸；身高；少许; v. 使缓慢地移动
example: The curtains were an inch too short.
translation: 窗帘短了一英寸。

meaning: v. 超越；胜过，优于；非…所能办到或理解
example: He had surpassed all our expectations .
translation: 他超越了我们所有的预期。

meaning: v. 演说；从事；忙于；写姓名地址；向…致辞；与…说话；提出；处理; n. 地址；演讲；致辞；说话的技巧；称呼
example: Send a stamped, self-addressed envelope (=  with your address on it so it can be sent back to you  ) .
translation: 寄上一个贴好邮票的、写有回邮地址的信封。

meaning: adj. 失踪的；缺少的; v. 错过（miss的ing形式）；想念；漏掉
example: We found the missing piece of the jigsaw under the chair.
translation: 我们在椅子下面找到了那块丢失的拼图。

meaning: n. 假设
example: One hypothesis is that the victim fell asleep while driving.
translation: 一种假设是受害人开车时睡着了。

meaning: n. 新奇；新奇的事物；新颖小巧而廉价的物品
example: Many toys have no attraction beyond their novelty value.
translation: 许多玩具除了有些新奇感之外，别无吸引力。

meaning: v. 保护，防卫；警戒
example: Are we doing enough to protect the environment?
translation: 我们在保护环境方面做得够吗？

meaning: n. 时钟；计时器; v. 记录；记时
example: I heard the clock strike six (= make six loud sounds ) .
translation: 我听到钟敲了六下。

meaning: v. 启发，启蒙；教导，开导；照耀
example: A few dedicated doctors have fought for years to enlighten the profession.
translation: 少数富有献身精神的医生为启蒙这一行业而奋斗多年。

meaning: n. （一个地区全部的）生物；生物学
example: a degree in biology
translation: 生物学学位

meaning: n. 比较；对照；比喻；比较关系
example: Her paintings invite comparison with those of the early Impressionists (= they remind you of them ) .
translation: 她的画作让人想起早期的印象派作品。

meaning: v. 完成；实现；达到
example: We have accomplished all we set out to do.
translation: 所有计划要做的事情，我们都已完成。

meaning: n. 观众；听众；读者；接见；正式会见；拜会
example: The audience began clapping and cheering.
translation: 观众开始鼓掌欢呼。

meaning: adj. 有利可图的；赚钱的；有益的
example: The advertising campaign proved very profitable.
translation: 事实证明，这次广告宣传活动卓有成效。

meaning: n. 自豪；骄傲；自尊心; v. 使得意，以…自豪
example: He wore his medals with pride.
translation: 他自豪地戴着奖章。

meaning: n. 危险；危险物，威胁
example: Danger! No boats beyond this point.
translation: 危险！船只不可越过此处。

meaning: n. 阻力；电阻；抵抗；反抗；抵抗力
example: disease resistance
translation: 抗病能力

meaning: v. 怨恨；愤恨；厌恶
example: Paul resented the fact that Carol didn’t trust him.
translation: 保罗非常气愤，因为卡萝尔不信任他。

meaning: adj. 熟悉的；常见的；亲近的; n. 常客；密友
example: It was a relief to be back in familiar surroundings .
translation: 回到熟悉的环境里让人松了一口气。

meaning: n. 性；性别；性交; v. 生（过去式gendered，过去分词gendered，现在分词gendering，第三人称单数genders，形容词genderless）
example: Discrimination on grounds of race or gender is forbidden.
translation: 严禁种族歧视和性别歧视。

meaning: n. 受害人；牺牲品；牺牲者
example: The victim received head injuries from which she died a week later.
translation: 受害人头部受伤，一周后死亡。

meaning: n. 摘要；[管理] 履历，简历; v. 重新开始，继续；恢复，重新占用
example: a brief résumé of the day’s events
translation: 当天活动的概述

meaning: n. 抓住；理解；控制; v. 抓住；领会
example: Luke took her arm in a firm grasp and led her through the gate.
translation: 卢克紧紧抓着她的胳膊，领她进了门。

meaning: adj. 邪恶的；不幸的；有害的；讨厌的; n. 罪恶，邪恶；不幸
example: an evil dictator responsible for the deaths of millions
translation: 应对数百万人之死负责的邪恶独裁者

meaning: adj. 有效的，起作用的；实际的，实在的；给人深刻印象
example: The cheaper drugs are just as effective in treating arthritis.
translation: 较便宜的药品对治疗关节炎同样有效。

meaning: v. 徘徊；漫步；迷路；离题
example: She wandered aimlessly about the house.
translation: 她漫无目的地在房子里走来走去。

meaning: v. 提取；取出；摘录；榨取; n. 汁；摘录；榨出物；选粹
example: You’ll have to have that tooth extracted.
translation: 你得把那颗牙拔掉。

meaning: adj. 依靠的；从属的；取决于…的; n. 依赖他人者；受赡养者
example: Jan’s mother was dependent on her for physical care.
translation: 简的母亲要靠简来照顾。

meaning: adj. 连贯的，一致的；明了的；清晰的；凝聚性的；互相耦合的；粘在一起的
example: The three years of the course are planned as a coherent whole.
translation: 这三年的课程是作为连贯的整体来安排的。

meaning: n. 挂钩，吊钩; v. 钩住；引上钩
example: Tom hung his coat on the hook behind the door.
translation: 汤姆把外套挂在门后的衣钩上。

meaning: n. 工厂；制造厂；代理店
example: a car factory
translation: 汽车制造厂

meaning: v. 更喜欢；宁愿；提出；提升
example: This type of owl prefers a desert habitat.
translation: 这种猫头鹰更喜欢沙漠的生活环境。

meaning: n. 指导，引导；领导
example: a missile with a sophisticated electronic guidance system
translation: 有精密电子制导系统的导弹

meaning: prep. 关于，至于
example: Regarding your recent inquiry, I have enclosed a copy of our new brochure.
translation: 关于你最近的咨询，我随信附上一本我们最新的手册。

meaning: n. 汽车（等于automobile）；自动; v. 乘汽车
example: imported autos
translation: 进口汽车

meaning: n. 事故；意外；[法] 意外事件；机遇
example: I met her quite by accident (=  completely by accident  ) .
translation: 我遇见她完全是偶然。

meaning: adj. 易受影响的；易感动的；容许…的; n. 易得病的人
example: A lot of TV advertising is aimed at susceptible young children.
translation: 很多电视广告瞄准了易受影响的幼儿。

meaning: adj. 统计的；统计学的
example: The report contains a great deal of statistical information.
translation: 该报告包含大量统计资料。

meaning: n. 学生；[解剖] 瞳孔；未成年人
example: About 20 pupils study music here.
translation: 大约20名小学生在这里学习音乐。

meaning: adj. 强烈的；紧张的；非常的；热情的
example: Young people today are under intense pressure to succeed.
translation: 如今的年轻人面临要出人头地的巨大压力。

meaning: adj. 更好的，更可取的；更合意的
example: For this dish, fresh herbs and garlic are preferable.
translation: 做这道菜，用新鲜香草和大蒜更好。

meaning: n. 恐慌，惊慌；大恐慌; adj. 恐慌的；没有理由的; v. 使恐慌
example: She got into a panic when she couldn’t find the tickets.
translation: 她找不到票，慌了起来。

meaning: n. 设备，装备；器材
example: a shop selling camping equipment
translation: 出售露营装备的商店

meaning: adj. 凉爽的；冷静的；出色的; v. 使…冷却；使…平静下来; n. 凉爽；凉爽的空气; adv. 冷静地
example: She swam out into the cool water.
translation: 她往外游向清凉的水里。

meaning: adj. 充足的；适当的；胜任的
example: Farmers have been slow to make adequate provision for their retirement.
translation: 农民们迟迟没有为退休做好适当安排。

meaning: n. 出席；到场；出席人数；考勤
example: We have an average attendance of 4,000 fans per game.
translation: 每场比赛平均有4,000名球迷来观战。

meaning: n. 船，舰；[组织] 脉管，血管；容器，器皿
example: a fishing vessel
translation: 渔船

meaning: v. 激发；鼓舞；启示；产生；使生灵感
example: We need someone who can inspire the team.
translation: 我们需要一个能鼓舞团队士气的人。

meaning: v. 开发，开拓；剥削；开采; n. 勋绩；功绩
example: Homeworkers can easily be exploited by employers.
translation: 在家工作的人容易被雇主剥削。

meaning: n. 收音机；无线电广播设备; v. 用无线电进行通信
example: The last 12 months have been difficult ones for local radio.
translation: 最近的12个月对地方广播电台来说是艰难的。

meaning: adj. 遥远的；偏僻的；疏远的; n. 远程
example: a remote border town
translation: 一个偏远的边境小镇

meaning: n. 文学；文献；文艺；著作
example: He has read many of the major works of literature.
translation: 他读过许多重要的文学作品。

meaning: n. 格式；版式；开本; v. 使格式化；规定…的格式
example: a large-format book for the partially-sighted
translation: 一本给弱视者阅读的大开本的书

meaning: n. 容器，接受者；容纳者; adj. 容易接受的，感受性强的
example: ...the largest recipient of U.S. foreign aid.
translation: …最大的美国对外援助接受方。

meaning: v. 说服，劝说；使某人相信；劝某人做（不做）某事; adj. 空闲的，有闲的
example: He was fairly easily persuaded .
translation: 他很轻易就被说服了。

meaning: n. 山峰；最高点；顶点；帽舌; v. 使达到最高点；使竖起; adj. 最高的；最大值的
example: Sales this month have reached a new peak .
translation: 本月的销售额创了新高。

meaning: v. 辩论，争论，讨论; n. 辩论；辩论会
example: The issue will be debated on Tuesday.
translation: 这个问题将在星期二讨论。

meaning: n. 表现，表示，表达；表情，脸色，态度，腔调，声调；式，符号；词句，语句，措辞，说法
example: Student leaders are demanding greater freedom of expression (= the right to say what you think without being punished ).
translation: 学生领袖要求得到更多的言论自由。

meaning: v. 授予；判定; n. 奖品；判决
example: Moodie has been awarded a golf scholarship at the University of Hawaii.
translation: 穆迪获授夏威夷大学高尔夫奖学金。

meaning: adv. 在国外；到海外; adj. 往国外的; n. 海外；异国
example: I’ve never lived abroad before.
translation: 我以前从未在国外生活过。

meaning: adj. 向前；在前的；领先; adv. 向前地；领先地；在（某人或某事物的）前面；预先；在将来，为未来
example: He kept his gaze fixed on the car ahead.
translation: 他的目光一直盯着前面的那辆汽车。

meaning: n. 障碍物，屏障；界线; v. 把…关入栅栏
example: He advocated the removal of trade barriers.
translation: 他提倡消除贸易壁垒。

meaning: v. 竞争；奋斗；斗争；争论
example: Inevitably, fights break out between the members of contending groups.
translation: 争权夺利的几个团体之间不可避免地发生了打斗。

meaning: n. 幸存，残存；幸存者，残存物
example: The doctors gave him a one in ten chance of survival .
translation: 医生说他有十分之一的生存希望。

meaning: n. 入口；进入; v. 使出神，使入迷
example: the station entrance
translation: 车站的入口处

meaning: n. 选择，挑选；选集；精选品
example: The judges have made their final selection.
translation: 评委已经作出最后的评选。

meaning: v. 出席；上（大学等）；照料；招待；陪伴
example: Only 12 people attended the meeting.
translation: 只有12个人出席了会议。

meaning: n. 挑战；挑动; v. 敢冒；不惧
example: Jones broke into a military base on a dare.
translation: 约翰接受了挑战，冲进一个军事基地。

meaning: adj. 比较的；相当的; n. 比较级；对手
example: After a lifetime of poverty, his last few years were spent in comparable comfort.
translation: 他穷了一辈子，最后几年还算过得比较舒适。

meaning: adj. 突然的，意外的；快速的; n. 突然发生的事
example: Life is cruel, she thought, with a sudden rush of anger.
translation: 生活真残酷，她想，心头突然涌上一股怒气。

meaning: v. 系；约束；打结；与…成平局; n. 领带；平局；鞋带；领结；不分胜负
example: He tied the ends of the plastic bag together.
translation: 他把塑料袋的两头系在一起。

meaning: n. 过道，门厅，走廊；会堂；食堂；学生宿舍；大厅，前厅；娱乐中心，会所

translation: 铺着地砖的大门厅

meaning: adj. 乐观的；乐观主义的

translation: 安德鲁抱有更为乐观的想法。

meaning: n. 赞扬；称赞；荣耀；崇拜; v. 赞美，歌颂；表扬

translation: 对小孩子多加表扬和鼓励是很重要的。

meaning: n. 借口；理由; v. 原谅；为…申辩；给…免去

translation: 我听厌了他的种种理由。

meaning: n. 主管人员；统治者，管理者；[自] 调节器；地方长官

translation: 监狱长

meaning: n. 手臂；武器；袖子；装备；部门; v. 武装起来

translation: 戴夫手臂断了。

meaning: n. 金字塔；角锥体; v. 渐增；上涨；成金字塔状

translation: 金字塔式管理体系中的不同层次

meaning: n. 脚；英尺；步调；末尾; v. 步行；跳舞；总计

translation: 我的脚底起泡了。

meaning: n. 发射；炮弹；射手；镜头; adj. 用尽的；破旧的；杂色的，闪光的; v. 射击（shoot的过去式和过去分词）
example: In the opening shot, we see Travolta’s feet walking down the sidewalk.
translation: 在开场的镜头中，我们看到特拉沃尔塔的脚在人行道上行走。

meaning: prep. 关于；就…而言; v. 涉及；使关心（concern的ing形式）；忧虑
example: calls from young children concerning lost pets
translation: 小孩子打来的有关宠物走失的电话

meaning: adj. 新鲜的；清新的；淡水的；无经验的; n. 开始；新生；泛滥; adv. 刚刚，才；最新地
example: I’ll just make some fresh coffee.
translation: 我来重新煮点咖啡。

meaning: v. （坚定地向某地）前进；行军，进军；游行示威；进展，进行; n. 行进，前进；行军；游行示威；进行曲
example: An estimated 5,000 people marched through the city to demonstrate against the factory closures.
translation: 大约有五千人在市里游行示威，抗议关闭工厂。

meaning: v. 观察；注视；看守；警戒; n. 手表；监视；守护；值班人
example: Do you mind if I watch?
translation: 你介意我看着吗？

meaning: n. 排；等级；军衔；队列; adj. 讨厌的；恶臭的；繁茂的; v. 排列；把…分等
example: He was sentenced to prison and stripped of his rank (= had his rank taken from him ) .
translation: 他被判入狱，并且被剥夺了军衔。

meaning: n. [化学] 氧气，[化学] 氧
example: The human brain needs to be without oxygen for only four minutes before permanent damage occurs.
translation: 人脑缺氧只需4分钟就会造成永久性损伤。

meaning: n. 信仰；信念；信任；忠实
example: People have lost faith in the government.
translation: 人们已失去了对政府的信心。

meaning: n. 雇用，租用；租金，工钱; v. 雇用；出租
example: a car hire company
translation: 汽车租赁公司

meaning: n. 膨胀；阐述；扩张物
example: The industry underwent a period of rapid expansion.
translation: 该产业经历了一轮快速扩张。

meaning: n. 迷信
example: the old superstition that walking under a ladder is unlucky
translation: 认为从梯子下面穿过不吉利的古老迷信

meaning: n. 技巧，技术；手法
example: He’s a great player, with brilliant technique.
translation: 他是个伟大的球员，球技十分精湛。

meaning: n. 口，嘴；河口; v. 做作地说，装腔作势地说；喃喃地说出
example: He lifted his glass to his mouth.
translation: 他把玻璃杯举到嘴边。

meaning: v. 植树于，使成为森林; n. 森林

translation: 热带森林

meaning: v. 调节，规定；控制；校准；有系统的管理
example: strict rules regulating the use of chemicals in food
translation: 限制化学品在食物中使用的严格规定

meaning: adj. 有效的；有根据的；合法的；正当的
example: Your return ticket is valid for three months.
translation: 你的往返票有效期为三个月。

meaning: v. 忽略；俯瞰；远眺；检查；高耸于…之上; n. 忽视；眺望

translation: 那样的小细节很容易被忽略。

meaning: n. 企业家；承包人；主办者
v. 借口；为辩护；托称
example: She stayed home from work, pleading illness.
translation: 她告病在家不去上班。

meaning: n. 椅子；讲座；（会议的）主席位；大学教授的职位; v. 担任（会议的）主席；使…入座；使就任要职
example: They bought a new table and chairs.
translation: 他们买了一套新的桌椅。

meaning: n. 链；束缚；枷锁; v. 束缚；囚禁；用铁链锁住
example: She had a gold chain around her neck.
translation: 她脖子上戴了条金项链。

meaning: adj. 痛苦的；疼痛的；令人不快的
example: Is your arm very painful?
translation: 你的手臂很疼吗？

meaning: v. 扩大；放大；详述
example: Police will have the pictures enlarged in an attempt to identify the thief.
translation: 为了确认窃贼的身份，警方会将这些照片放大。

meaning: n. 肩，肩膀；肩部; v. 肩负，承担
example: She tapped the driver on the shoulder.
translation: 她拍拍司机的肩。

meaning: adj. 试验性的，暂定的；踌躇的; n. 假设，试验
example: I passed on my tentative conclusions to the police.
translation: 我把我的初步结论递交给了警方。

meaning: adj. 奇数的；古怪的；剩余的；临时的；零散的; n. 奇数；怪人；奇特的事物
example: It was an odd thing to say.
translation: 这话说得很奇怪。

meaning: n. 政治家；国务活动家
example: a respected elder statesman
translation: 一位受人尊敬的政界元老

meaning: n. 放任；狂热; v. 遗弃；放弃
example: He approached life with reckless abandon–I don't think he himself knew what he was going to do next.
translation: 他以不计后果的放纵态度对待生活–我想他自己都不知道他接下来要做什么。

meaning: v. 关联; n. 相关物；相关联的人; adj. 关联的
example: Attempts to correlate specific language functions with particular parts of the brain have not advanced very far.
translation: 试图把特定的语言功能和大脑特定区域相联系的努力还没有取得很大进展。

meaning: v. 使…相异；使…不同
example: The story he told police differed from the one he told his mother.
translation: 他告诉警察的话和告诉他母亲的不同。

meaning: adv. 当然；行（用于回答）；必定
example: ‘I’d like a beer, please.’ ‘Certainly, sir.’
translation: “请给我来杯啤酒。”“好的，先生。”

meaning: adj. 沉重的；繁重的，巨大的；拥挤的；阴沉的; n. 重物；严肃角色; adv. 大量地；笨重地
example: The wardrobe was too heavy for me to move on my own.
translation: 衣橱太重，我一个人移不动。

meaning: adj. 耐用的，持久的; n. 耐用品
example: Wood is a durable material.
translation: 木头是耐用材料。

meaning: v. 盛行，流行；战胜，获胜
example: Justice will prevail.
translation: 正义终将获胜。

meaning: n. 野心，雄心；抱负，志向; v. 追求；有…野心
example: He was young and full of ambition.
translation: 他年轻，而且雄心勃勃。

meaning: n. 荣誉；信用；头衔; v. 尊敬（等于honour）；给…以荣誉
v. 分离；使分离；劈开；离开；分解; n. 劈开；裂缝; adj. 劈开的
example: We agreed to split the cost .
translation: 我们同意分摊这笔费用。

meaning: n. 指标；指数；索引；指针; v. 做索引
example: ...the consumer price index.
translation: …消费价格指数。

meaning: adj. 外国的；外交的；异质的；不相关的
example: Can you speak any foreign languages?
translation: 你会讲外语吗？

meaning: n. 供给，补给；供应品; v. 供给，提供；补充
example: The nation’s fuel supplies will not last forever.
translation: 这个国家的燃料供应不会无穷无尽。

meaning: n. 处置；[心理] 性情；[军] 部署；倾向
