meaning: adj. 强健的；健康的；粗野的；粗鲁的

meaning: n. 自动化；自动操作

meaning: n. 兄弟；同事；战友; int. 我的老兄！

meaning: v. 摇动；骚动；使…激动

meaning: v. 沉浸；使陷入

meaning: v. 推翻；倾覆；破坏; n. 倾覆；周转；破灭

meaning: n. 算术，算法

example: The inside of the bag was lined with soft leather.
translation: 这包的里面衬了软皮。

meaning: n. 撞碎；坠毁；破产；轰隆声；睡觉; v. 摔碎；坠落；发出隆隆声；(金融企业等)破产
example: a crash victim
translation: 车祸受害者

meaning: v. 引起，唤起；博得
example: The photographs evoked strong memories of our holidays in France.
translation: 那些照片勾起了我们到法国度假的深刻回忆。

meaning: n. 红利；股息；[数] 被除数；奖金
example: The first quarter dividend has been increased by nearly 4 percent.
translation: 第一季度的股息增加了近4％。

meaning: adj. 电的；电动的；发电的；导电的；令人震惊的; n. 电；电气车辆；带电体
example: an electric blanket
translation: 电热毯

meaning: v. 埋葬；隐藏
example: Electric cables are buried beneath the streets.
translation: 电缆埋在街道的下面。

meaning: v. 摔倒；倒塌；滚动；打滚；仓惶地行动; n. 跌倒；翻筋斗；跌跤
example: A small boy tumbled off the porch.
translation: 一个小男孩从门廊上摔了下去。

meaning: adj. 外交的；外交上的；老练的
example: Diplomatic efforts to end the fighting began on October 25.
translation: 停战的外交努力于10月25日开始。

meaning: n. 难民，避难者；流亡者，逃亡者
example: Refugees were streaming across the border.
translation: 难民正涌过边境。

meaning: n. 酒馆；客栈
example: Do you fancy going to the pub?
translation: 你想去酒吧吗？

meaning: n. 鸽子；鸽派人士; v. 潜水（dive的过去式）
example: As part of the study, due to be unveiled later this month, participants were given the option of being a ‘dove’ and cooperating with others for shared benefit, or taking on the role of a ‘hawk’.
translation: 该项研究的具体内容将会在本月末公布，其中的一项内容是一个游戏，参与者可以选择成为“鸽派”的角色， 与他人合作共享利益， 或者成为“鹰派”的角色。

meaning: n. 致敬，欢迎；敬礼; v. 行礼致敬，欢迎
example: As they left, the corporal gave them a respectful salute.
translation: 他们离开时，下士恭敬地向他们行礼。

meaning: n. 铃，钟；钟声，铃声；钟状物; v. 装钟于，系铃于
example: church bells
translation: 教堂的钟

meaning: adj. 英雄的；英勇的；记叙英雄及其事迹的；夸张的; n. 史诗；英勇行为
example: She portrayed him as a heroic figure .
translation: 她把他描述为英雄人物。

meaning: n. 地壳；外壳；面包皮；坚硬外皮; v. 结硬皮；结成外壳
example: sandwiches with the crusts cut off
translation: 切去边皮的三明治

meaning: n. 仁慈；好意；友好的行为
example: I can’t thank you enough for your kindness.
translation: 你的好意我感激不尽。

meaning: n. 伏特（电压单位）；环骑；闪避
v. 压碎；弄皱，变形；使…挤入; n. 粉碎；迷恋；压榨；拥挤的人群
example: His leg was crushed in the accident.
translation: 他的腿在事故中被压断。

meaning: n. 独木舟；轻舟; v. 乘独木舟
example: We saw the canoe overturn, throwing its passengers into the water.
translation: 我们看到独木舟倾覆了，把上面的乘客掀入水中。

meaning: n. 驾驶室；出租汽车；出租马车; v. 乘出租马车（或汽车）
example: Ralph tried to hail a cab (= wave to get a cab to stop for you ) .
translation: 拉尔夫招手想叫一辆出租车。

meaning: n. 宿舍（等于dormitory）
example: But I had no food in my dorm, so I had to go to canteen.
translation: 但是我在宿舍没有东西可吃，所以我只能去餐厅了。

meaning: n. 请愿；请愿书；祈求；[法] 诉状; v. 请愿；请求
example: Local residents have drawn up a petition to protest the hospital closure.
translation: 当地居民已草拟了一份请愿书，抗议关闭医院。

meaning: v. 围绕；装入；放入封套
example: Please enclose a cheque with your order.
translation: 请随订单附上支票。

meaning: v. 发出，放射；发行；发表
example: The kettle emitted a shrill whistle.
translation: 水壶发出了刺耳的鸣笛声。

meaning: n. 果园；果树林
example: a cherry orchard
translation: 樱桃园

meaning: v. 中断；打断；插嘴；妨碍; n. 中断
example: Will you stop interrupting me!
translation: 别打断我的话！

meaning: n. 并发症；复杂；复杂化；混乱
example: The fact that the plane was late added a further complication to our journey.
translation: 飞机误点给我们的旅行带来了更大的麻烦。

meaning: n. 碑；药片；写字板；小块；平板电脑; v. 用碑牌纪念；将(备忘录等)写在板上；将…制成小片或小块
example: She took a couple of headache tablets .
translation: 她吃了几片头痛药。

meaning: n. 睡椅，长沙发；床；卧榻; v. 蹲伏，埋伏；躺着
example: Tom offered to sleep on the couch.
translation: 汤姆说他来睡沙发。

meaning: v. 凝视；注视; n. 凝视；注视
example: Patrick sat gazing into space  (= looking straight in front, not at any particular person or thing ).
translation: 帕特里克坐着，茫然地看着前方。

meaning: adj. 经济的；节约的；合算的
example: A small car is more economical to run.
translation: 开小型汽车比较省油。

meaning: n. 被子；棉被; v. 东拼西凑地编；加软衬料后缝制
example: ...an old patchwork quilt.
translation: …一条旧的拼布被子。

meaning: adj. 帝国的；皇帝的；至高无上的；威严的; n. 纸张尺寸；特等品
example: Britain’s imperial expansion in the 19th century
translation: 19世纪英帝国的扩张

meaning: adj. 传染的；传染性的；易传染的
example: Flu is highly infectious.
translation: 流感传染性很强。

meaning: v. 用糖煮；使结晶为砂糖；美化; n. 糖果（等于sweets）；冰糖（等于sugar candy，rock candy）；毒品; adj. 新潮的（服饰）；甜言蜜语的
example: ...a piece of candy.
translation: …一块糖果。

meaning: n. 口香糖；树胶；橡皮; v. 用胶粘，涂以树胶；使…有粘性
example: I do not chew gum in public.
translation: 我不在公共场合嚼口香糖。

meaning: adj. 不透明的；不传热的；迟钝的; n. 不透明物; v. 使不透明；使不反光
example: a shower with an opaque glass door
translation: 装有不透明玻璃门的淋浴间

meaning: n. 家务事
example: Men are doing more housework nowadays.
translation: 现今男人正在承担越来越多的家务。

meaning: n. 五十；五十个；编号为50的东西; adj. 五十的；五十个的；众多的
example: Standards of living rose in the fifties.
translation: 50年代生活水平提高了。

meaning: n. [化]汞，水银
example: Some thieves have eaten off their irons with mercury water.
translation: 有些窃贼用汞水腐蚀他们的镣铐。

meaning: n. 通道，走道；侧廊
example: Would you like a window seat or an aisle seat (=  seat next to the aisle  ) ?
translation: 您想要靠窗的座位还是靠过道的座位？

meaning: n. 嗜好；业余爱好
example: What are your hobbies?
translation: 你有些什么爱好？

meaning: n. 流放，充军；放逐，被放逐者；流犯; v. 放逐，流放；使背井离乡
example: political exiles
translation: 政治流亡者

meaning: n. [临床] 综合症状；并发症状；校验子；并发位
example: people who suffer from irritable bowel syndrome
translation: 患有肠道过敏综合征的人

meaning: n. 半径，半径范围；[解剖] 桡骨；辐射光线；有效航程
example: The shock of the explosion was felt over a radius of forty miles.
translation: 爆炸引起的剧烈震动在方圆40英里内都能感觉得到。

meaning: v. 检查；视察；检阅
example: I got out of the car to inspect the damage.
translation: 我下车查看损坏情况。

meaning: n. 遗赠，遗产
example: She received a small legacy from her aunt.
translation: 她从姨妈那里继承了一小笔遗产。

meaning: adj. 柠檬色的; n. 柠檬
example: A lemon is an acid fruit.
translation: 柠檬是一种酸味水果。

meaning: v. 渗透，透过；弥漫
example: The smell of diesel oil permeated the air.
translation: 空气里充斥着柴油的气味。

meaning: v. 波动；涨落；动摇
example: Insect populations fluctuate wildly from year to year.
translation: 昆虫的数量每年变化很大。

meaning: n. 宝石；珠宝; v. 镶以宝石；饰以珠宝
example: She loved dressing up and wearing priceless jewels.
translation: 她喜欢穿上盛装，戴上极为昂贵的珠宝首饰。

meaning: n. 运输；运输机；狂喜；流放犯; v. 运输；流放；使狂喜
example: It’s easier to get to the college if you have your own transport (= a car, bicycle etc ) .
translation: 如果你有自己的交通工具，去学院就会更方便。

meaning: n. 告别，辞别；再见；再会; int. 别了！（常含有永别或不容易再见面的意思）；再会！; adj. 告别的
example: Mourners gathered to bid farewell to the victims of the plane tragedy.
translation: 哀悼者来向空难受害者告别。

meaning: n. 木匠，木工; v. 当木匠，做木匠工作
example: He is a carpenter by profession.
translation: 他以木工为业。

meaning: n. 说服；说服力；信念；派别
example: After a little gentle persuasion , Debbie agreed to let us in.
translation: 好言劝说了几句后，黛比就同意让我们进去了。

meaning: v. 监禁; n. 监狱
v. 轻视，鄙视
example: She despised her neighbours.
translation: 她看不起她的邻居。

meaning: n. [法] 陪审团；评判委员会; adj. 应急的
example: The jury found him not guilty.
translation: 陪审团裁定他无罪。

meaning: n. 动脉；干道；主流
example: ...Connecticut Ave., one of the main arteries of Washington.
translation: …康涅狄格大道，华盛顿的主干道之一。

meaning: n. 丝绸；蚕丝；丝织物; adj. 丝的；丝绸的；丝制的; v. （玉米）处于长须的阶段中
example: pure silk stockings
translation: 生丝面料的漂亮连衣裙

meaning: n. 男人，家伙; v. 嘲弄，取笑
example: Dave’s a nice guy when you get to know him.
translation: 戴夫是个好人，你了解他后就知道了。

meaning: adj. 浪漫的；多情的；空想的; n. 浪漫的人; v. 使…浪漫化
example: ‘Tom always sends me red roses on my birthday.’ ‘How romantic!’
translation: “我过生日时汤姆总是给我送红玫瑰。”“多浪漫啊！”

meaning: n. 内脏；肠子；剧情；胆量；海峡；勇气；直觉；肠; v. 取出内脏；摧毁（建筑物等）的内部; adj. 简单的；本质的，根本的；本能的，直觉的
example: He had a gut feeling that Sarah was lying.
translation: 他凭直觉感到萨拉在撒谎。

meaning: adj. 沉闷的；冗长乏味的
example: The work was tiring and tedious.
translation: 这工作既累人又枯燥。

meaning: adj. 友好的；亲切的；支持的；融洽的，和睦的; adv. 友善地；温和地
example: I’ve found a great pub – good beer and a friendly atmosphere.
translation: 我找到了一家很棒的酒馆——啤酒好，氛围也亲切。

meaning: n. 痛苦；苦恼; v. 使极度痛苦
example: the anguish of not knowing what had happened to her
translation: 由于不知道她发生了什么事而痛苦不堪

meaning: n. 枪支；枪状物；持枪歹徒; v. 用枪射击；加大油门快速前进
example: I’ve never fired a gun in my life.
translation: 我这辈子从来没开过枪。

meaning: n. 技工，机修工; adj. 手工的
example: a garage mechanic
translation: 汽车修理厂的技工

meaning: n. 征服，战胜；战利品
example: the Norman Conquest (= the conquest of England by the Normans )
translation: 诺曼征服

meaning: adj. 生理学的，生理的
example: If so, this would add to a growing list of physiological and biological markers of sexual orientation.
translation: 如果是这样，这可能会给生理和生物学上的性取向标记增加一长串名单。

meaning: n. 臭虫，小虫；故障；窃听器; v. 烦扰，打扰；装窃听器
example: There’s a nasty bug going round (=  that a lot of people have caught  ) .
translation: 现在流行着一种很烦人的传染病。

meaning: n. 诅咒；咒骂; v. 诅咒；咒骂
example: He muttered a curse under his breath.
translation: 他低声骂了一句。

meaning: n. 徽章；证章；标记; v. 授给…徽章
example: We were each handed a badge with our name on it.
translation: 我们每个人都拿到一个徽章，上面有我们的名字。

meaning: n. 群；一伙；一组; v. 使成群结队；结伙伤害或恐吓某人
example: Several gangs were operating in the area.
translation: 有好几个犯罪团伙在这个地区活动。

meaning: n. 芽，萌芽；蓓蕾; v. 发芽，萌芽
example: rose buds
translation: 玫瑰花苞

meaning: n. 核，核心；原子核
example: Neutrons and protons are bound together in the nucleus of an atom.
translation: 在一个原子的核内，中子和质子聚合在一起。

meaning: n. 褐雨燕; adj. 快的；迅速的；敏捷的；立刻的; adv. 迅速地
example: My letter received a swift reply.
translation: 我的信很快就得到了回复。

meaning: adj. 奢侈的；浪费的；过度的；放纵的
example: Would it be too extravagant to buy both?
translation: 把两个都买下会不会太奢侈了？

meaning: adj. 潜在的；潜伏的；隐藏的
example: latent aggression
translation: 潜在的侵略

meaning: n. 牛肉；肌肉；食用牛；牢骚; v. 抱怨，告发；发牢骚
example: We have both dairy and beef cattle on the farm.
translation: 我们农场里奶牛和菜牛都有。

meaning: adj. 名义上的；有名无实的；[会计] 票面上的; n. [语] 名词性词
example: Their conversion to Christianity was only nominal.
translation: 他们只是名义上皈依了基督教。

meaning: v. 复制；再生；生殖；使…在脑海中重现
example: The turtles return to the coast to reproduce.
translation: 海龟回到岸上繁殖。

meaning: n. 地质学；地质情况
example: He was visiting professor of geology at the University of Georgia.
translation: 他曾是佐治亚大学的地质学客座教授。

meaning: n. 啤酒; v. 喝啤酒
example: We sell draught beer (=  beer served from a large container, not a bottle  ) .
translation: 我们出售散装啤酒。

meaning: n. 匆忙，急忙; v. 仓促（做某事）；催促；（朝某方向）迅速移动；迅速处理
example: Sorry, I can’t stop, I’m in a hurry.
translation: 对不起，我不能停下，我赶时间。

meaning: n. 调查；测量；审视；纵览; v. 调查；勘测；俯瞰
example: The council conducted a survey of the uses to which farm buildings are put.
translation: 该委员会对农场建筑的用途进行了一个调查。

meaning: n. 长袍，长外衣；礼服；睡袍；法衣; v. 使穿睡衣
example: a hospital gown
translation: 医院手术服

meaning: adj. 神圣的；非凡的；天赐的；极好的; v. 占卜；预言；用占卜勘探; n. 牧师；神学家
example: divine power
translation: 神的力量

meaning: n. 舌头；语言; v. 舔；斥责；用舌吹
example: Joe ran his tongue over his dry lips.
translation: 乔舔了舔干燥的嘴唇。

meaning: v. 下沉；消沉；渗透; n. 水槽；洗涤槽；污水坑
example: Their motorboat struck a rock and began to sink.
translation: 他们的摩托艇触了礁，开始下沉。

meaning: v. 唱歌；歌颂；鸣叫；呼号; n. 演唱；鸣声；呼啸声
example: She can sing beautifully.
translation: 她唱歌很好听。

meaning: v. 高兴；庆祝
example: This should be wonderful news for... well, for all women born in 1979 and 1980, who can rejoice in the realisation that they are – or are about to be – at their peak.
translation: 这对所有在1979 和1980 年出生的女人来说应该是一个很棒的消息，她们会为自己正处于或即将处于人生的黄金时刻而感到高兴。

meaning: v. 倾斜；投掷；搭帐篷；坠落; n. 沥青；音高；程度；树脂；倾斜；投掷；球场
example: Try and pitch your tent on level ground.
translation: 试试在平地上搭帐篷。

meaning: n. 自助餐厅
example: the school cafeteria
translation: 学校餐厅

meaning: n. 手推车；（美）有轨电车（等于trolley car）；（英）无轨电车（等于trolleybus）；空中吊运车; v. 乘电车; v. 用手推车运
example: a supermarket trolley
translation: 超市购物手推车

meaning: v. 抹去；擦除
example: The computer crashed, and all our records were erased.
translation: 计算机瘫痪了，我们所有的记录都被删除了。

meaning: v. 喷射；驱逐，逐出
example: Two engines cut out and the plane started to eject fuel as it lost height.
translation: 两个发动机突然熄火，飞机在下降的同时开始喷出燃料。

meaning: adj. 惭愧的，感到难为情的；耻于……的
example: Everyone cries sometimes – it’s nothing to be ashamed of.
translation: 每个人都会有哭的时候——没什么好难为情的。

meaning: n. 垃圾，废物；舢板
example: This cupboard’s full of junk.
translation: 这个壁橱里塞满了杂物。

meaning: n. 补语；余角；补足物; v. 补足，补助
example: The green wallpaper is the perfect complement to the old pine of the dresser.
translation: 绿色墙纸是旧松木梳妆台的完美衬托。

meaning: adj. 上面的，上部的；较高的
example: the upper lip
translation: 上唇

meaning: adj. 有希望的；有前途的; n. 有希望成功的人
example: The vote is a hopeful sign that attitudes in the church are changing.
translation: 投票结果是个好兆头，表明教会的态度正在转变。

meaning: n. 关税表；收费表; v. 定税率；征收关税
example: America wants to eliminate tariffs on items such as electronics.
translation: 美国想要取消电子类产品的关税。

meaning: v. 理解；包含；由…组成
example: She cannot comprehend the extent of the disaster.
translation: 她无法理解这场灾难的严重程度。

meaning: n. [微] 细菌；杆菌属
v. 跌跌撞撞地走；犯大错; n. 大错
example: They blundered badly when they gave him the job.
translation: 他们犯了大错，让他做这份工作。

meaning: n. 电冰箱
example: Then all three of you sign the contract and post in on the fridge.
translation: 然后你们三个人要都在协议上签名，并把它贴在冰箱上。

meaning: n. 毛巾，手巾；[纸] 纸巾; v. 用毛巾擦
example: Have you got a clean towel I could use?
translation: 你有没有干净毛巾给我用？

meaning: n. 步枪；来复枪; v. 用步枪射击；抢夺；偷走
example: They shot him at point blank range with an automatic rifle.
translation: 他们用一支自动步枪在近距离射程内射中了他。

meaning: n. 懦夫，懦弱的人; adj. 胆小的，懦怯的
example: Try it. Don’t be such a coward.
translation: 试一下，别那么胆小。

meaning: v. 大叫，叫喊; n. 喊声，叫声
example: ‘Help me!’ she yelled hysterically.
translation: “救救我！”她歇斯底里地大叫。

meaning: n. 喷泉，泉水；源泉
example: He was a fountain of information on Asian affairs.
translation: 他是亚洲事务的信息源。

meaning: n. 障碍；阻碍；妨碍
example: John was irritated by drivers parking near his house and causing an obstruction.
translation: 约翰被众司机在他房子附近停车而造成阻塞所激怒。

meaning: adj. 多余的，过剩的；被解雇的，失业的；冗长的，累赘的
example: Seventy factory workers were made redundant in the resulting cuts.
translation: 在继而发生的裁员中，70名工厂工人被解雇。

meaning: n. 面纱；面罩；遮蔽物；托词; v. 遮蔽；掩饰；以面纱遮掩；用帷幕分隔
example: She lifted her veil with both hands.
translation: 她用双手揭开面纱。

meaning: n. 骨架，骨骼；纲要；骨瘦如柴的人; adj. 骨骼的；骨瘦如柴的；概略的
example: We agreed on a skeleton outline of the proposal.
translation: 我们给提案商定了一个基本框架。

meaning: v. 熄灭，[机] 淬火；解渴；结束；冷浸
example: We stopped at a small bar to quench our thirst.
translation: 我们在一家小酒吧停下来喝点东西解渴。

meaning: n. 血管；叶脉；[地质] 岩脉；纹理；翅脉；性情; v. 使成脉络；象脉络般分布于
example: She felt the blood racing through her veins as they kissed.
translation: 他们接吻时她觉得热血沸腾。

meaning: n. 配额；定额；限额
example: The government has decided to scrap quotas on car imports.
translation: 政府决定取消汽车进口配额。

meaning: adj. 可理解的；明了的；仅能用智力了解的
example: The language of Darwin was intelligible to experts and non-experts alike.
translation: 达尔文的语言对专家和平常人来说都容易理解。

meaning: n. 吹；打击；殴打; v. 风吹；喘气
example: Joe resigned, which was a severe blow because we needed him desperately.
translation: 乔辞职了，这是一个巨大的打击，因为我们非常需要他。

meaning: v. 奉承；谄媚；使高兴
example: Perry would always flatter Mrs. Mitchell by praising her cooking.
translation: 佩里常常奉承米切尔太太，称赞她的烹调手艺。

meaning: adj. 小数的；十进位的; n. 小数
example: changing to a decimal system
translation: 改为十进制

meaning: v. 诊断；断定
example: How did they diagnose you?
translation: 他们怎么给你的诊断的？

meaning: n. 醋
example: The  sugared  vinegar is  refined from the sugarcane and  pine.
translation: 加糖的醋是从甘蔗和松木中精炼出来的.

meaning: v. 感染，传染
example: People with the virus may feel perfectly well, but they can still infect others.
translation: 带有这种病毒的人可能毫无症状，却仍可能传染他人。

meaning: n. 服装，装束；戏装，剧装; v. 给…穿上服装
example: the film’s lavish costumes and spectacular sets
translation: 影片中奢华的戏装和壮观的场景

meaning: n. 小偷，贼
example: Thieves broke into the offices and stole $150,000’s worth of computer equipment.
translation: 小偷破门进入办公室，偷走了价值15万美元的电脑设备。

meaning: n. 火鸡；笨蛋；失败之作
example: roast turkey
translation: 烤火鸡

meaning: n. [军] 机动；演习；策略；调遣; v. [军] 机动；演习；调遣；用计谋
n. 薄雾；视线模糊不清；模糊不清之物; v. 下雾；变模糊
example: We could just see the outline of the house through the mist.
translation: 薄雾中我们只能看到房子的轮廓。

meaning: n. 弓形，拱形；拱门; adj. 主要的; v. 使…弯成弓形；用拱连接
example: When she passed under the arch leading out of the park, Mira whooped with delight.
translation: 从通向公园外的拱门下走过时，米拉高兴地喊叫起来。

meaning: n. 装货；装载的货物
example: The goods are ready for shipment.
translation: 货物已经准备好装运。

meaning: adj. 阴冷的；荒凉的，无遮蔽的；黯淡的，无希望的；冷酷的；单调的
example: The landscape was bleak.
translation: 景色一片凄凉。

meaning: n. 炉，灶；烤炉，烤箱
example: Preheat the oven to 200 degrees C.
translation: 把烤箱预热至200摄氏度。

meaning: n. 虚伪；伪善
example: It would be sheer hypocrisy to pray for success, since I’ve never believed in God.
translation: 我从不相信上帝，因此为获成功而祈祷是纯粹的虚伪之举。

meaning: v. 解雇；卸下；放出；免除; n. 排放；卸货；解雇
example: Hospitals now tend to discharge patients earlier than in the past.
translation: 与过去相比，现在医院更趋向于让病人早些出院。

meaning: n. 琐事；蛋糕；少量; v. 开玩笑；闲混；嘲弄
example: There’s no point in arguing over trifles.
translation: 为琐事争吵毫无意义。

meaning: n. 圆周；周长；胸围
example: ...a scientist calculating the Earth's circumference.
translation: …一位正在计算地球周长的科学家。

meaning: n. 克隆；无性系；无性繁殖；靠营养生殖而由母体分离繁殖的植物; v. 无性繁殖，复制
v. 放牧；擦伤; n. 放牧；轻擦
example: I fell on the gravel, severely grazing my knee.
translation: 我摔倒在砾石路上，膝盖擦伤得很严重。

meaning: n. 地下室；地窖
example: They bought an old schoolhouse to live in and built a workshop in the basement.
translation: 他们买了座旧校舍居住，还在地下室建了个作坊。

meaning: adj. 可比较的；比得上的
example: A car of comparable size would cost far more abroad.
translation: 同样大小的汽车在国外要贵得多。

meaning: n. 二月
example: He joined the Army in February 1943.
translation: 他1943年2月参军。

meaning: n. [电] 电压
example: The systems are getting smaller and using lower voltages.
translation: 这些系统正变得更小而且使用更低的电压。

meaning: adj. 乐器的；有帮助的；仪器的，器械的; n. 器乐曲；工具字，工具格
example: ...a CD of vocal and instrumental music.
translation: …一张声乐和器乐光盘。

meaning: n. 拳，拳头；〈口〉笔迹；掌握；[印]指标参见号; v. 紧握；握成拳；用拳打
example: She held the money tightly in her fist.
translation: 她把钱紧紧地攥在手中。

meaning: n. 胡萝卜
example: grated carrots
translation: 磨碎的胡萝卜

meaning: v. 旋，拧；压榨；强迫; n. 螺旋；螺丝钉；吝啬鬼
example: "Yes, I know that," Kelly said, screwing the silencer onto the pistol.
translation: “是的，我知道那事。”凯利一边把消音器拧到手枪上一边说道。

meaning: n. 大腿，股
example: chicken thighs
translation: 鸡腿

meaning: adj. 可怕的；极讨厌的
example: The weather has been really horrible all week.
translation: 整个星期天气都很糟。

meaning: n. 油；石油；油画颜料; v. 加油；涂油；使融化
example: a rise in the price of oil
translation: 石油价格的上涨

meaning: n. 导弹；投射物; adj. 导弹的；可投掷的；用以发射导弹的
example: a nuclear missile
translation: 核导弹

meaning: v. 退还；偿还，归还; n. 退款；偿还，偿还额
example: I took the radio back, and they refunded my money .
translation: 我把收音机送回去，他们给我退了款。

meaning: adj. [气象][物] 潮湿的；有雨的; n. 雨天；湿气; v. 弄湿
example: I’ve washed your shirt but it’s still wet.
translation: 我把你的衬衫洗过了，不过现在还是湿的。

meaning: adj. 健全的；理智的；[临床] 神志正常的
example: He seems perfectly sane (= completely sane ) to me.
translation: 在我看来他神志完全正常。

meaning: n. 沙；沙地；沙洲；沙滩；沙子; v. 撒沙于；以沙掩盖；用砂纸等擦平或磨光某物；使撒沙似地布满；给…掺沙子
example: I have sand in my shoe.
translation: 我的鞋里有沙子。

meaning: n. 楼梯，阶梯；梯级
example: We walked up four flights of stairs (= sets of stairs ) .
translation: 我们往上走了四段楼梯。

meaning: n. 蒸气（等于vapor）；水蒸气

translation: 水蒸气

meaning: v. 统一；使相同，使一致
example: Strong support for the war has unified the nation.
translation: 对战争的坚决支持使这个国家团结了起来。

meaning: n. 内地；内陆; adj. 内陆的；内地的；国内的; adv. 在内地；向内地；向内陆；在内陆
example: The next day, we drove inland.
translation: 第二天，我们乘车开往内陆。

meaning: n. [化学] 氢
example: Water contains hydrogen and oxygen.
translation: 水含有氢和氧。

meaning: adj. 聪明的；机灵的；熟练的

translation: 聪明的人

meaning: v. 繁殖；饲养；产生; n. [生物] 品种；种类，类型
example: Eagles breed during the cooler months of the year.
translation: 鹰在一年中较凉爽的季节交配繁殖。

meaning: adv. 总是；不变地；一定地
example: It invariably rains when I go there.
translation: 我每次去那儿都下雨。

meaning: n. 演讲；讲稿；教训; v. 演讲；训诫

translation: …埃里克·鲁滨逊教授的系列讲座。

meaning: n. 货摊；畜栏；托辞; v. 停止，停转；拖延

translation: 市场摊位

meaning: n. 暴风雪；雪暴

translation: 暴风雪增加了我们的困难。

meaning: n. 边界；范围；分界线
example: National boundaries are becoming increasingly meaningless in the global economy.
translation: 在全球经济中，国界已经变得越来越没有意义。

meaning: n. 黑人; adj. 黑人的

translation: 奴隶制，“对于黑人、白人与合众国来说都是一种彻底的邪恶，”1850年林肯如此说道。

meaning: n. 暂停；间歇; v. 暂停，停顿，中止；踌躇

translation: 艾丽斯换磁带的时候出现了短暂的停顿。

meaning: n. 投票；民意测验；投票数；投票所; v. 投票；剪短；对…进行民意测验；获得选票; adj. 无角的；剪过毛的；修过枝的
example: A recent poll found that 80% of Californians support the governor.
translation: 最近的一项民意调查发现80%的加利福尼亚人支持州长。

meaning: n. 杆；极点；电极; v. 用竿支撑
example: a telephone pole
translation: 电话线杆

meaning: adj. 麻烦的；讨厌的；使人苦恼的
example: a troublesome child
translation: 烦人的孩子

meaning: adj. 椭圆的；卵形的; n. 椭圆形；卵形
example: ...the small oval framed picture of a little boy.
translation: …一个小男孩的镶在椭圆形框架里的小幅照片。

meaning: n. 刺痛；讽刺，刺激；刺毛; v. 刺；驱使；使…苦恼；使…疼痛
example: She felt the sting of tears in her eyes.
translation: 她感觉泪水刺痛了眼睛。

meaning: n. 障碍；不利条件，不利的因素; v. 妨碍，阻碍；使不利
example: Not speaking the language is a real handicap.
translation: 不会讲这种语言的确是一个障碍。

meaning: n. 道歉；谢罪；辩护；勉强的替代物
example: Edward can’t be here today, but he sends his apologies .
translation: 爱德华今天来不了，他向大家表示歉意。

meaning: n. 肖像；描写；半身雕塑像

translation: 她已受托为杰克逊画肖像。

meaning: v. 受压缩小
example: Light silk is best for parachutes, as it compresses well and then expands rapidly.
translation: 轻质丝绸最适合制作降落伞，因为这种面料便于压缩，而且展开迅速。

meaning: n. 咳嗽，咳嗽声；咳嗽病; v. 咳出
example: He’s got a bad cough.
translation: 他咳嗽得很厉害。

meaning: v. 后退；减弱
example: Just as I started to think that I was never going to get well, the illness began to recede.
translation: 就在我开始认为我将永远不会好起来的时候，我的病开始好转。

meaning: adj. 灵巧的；整洁的；优雅的；齐整的；未搀水的；平滑的
example: His clothes were always neat and clean.
translation: 他的衣服总是很整洁。

meaning: n. （植物的）茎，秆；（支持叶子、果实和花的）梗，柄；追踪；高视阔步; v. 追踪，潜近；高视阔步

translation: 芹菜茎

meaning: adj. 陈腐的；不新鲜的; v. 变陈旧；撒尿；变得不新鲜; n. 尿
example: French bread goes stale (= becomes stale ) very quickly.
translation: 法式面包极易变味。

meaning: n. 盐；风趣，刺激性; adj. 咸水的；含盐的，咸味的；盐腌的；猥亵的; v. 用盐腌；给…加盐；将盐撒在道路上使冰或雪融化
example: This might need some salt and pepper.
translation: 这里面也许要加点盐和胡椒粉。

meaning: n. 英镑；重击，重击声；兽栏；拘留所; v. 捣烂；敲打；监禁，拘留
example: They spent over a thousand pounds.
translation: 他们花了一千多英镑。

meaning: n. 脖子；衣领；海峡; v. 搂著脖子亲吻；变狭窄
example: Mike rubbed the back of his neck.
translation: 迈克揉了揉后颈。

meaning: v. 投；抛；掷; n. 投掷；冒险
example: The bus stopped suddenly and we were all thrown forwards.
translation: 公共汽车猛地停住，我们都往前栽。

meaning: v. 筑成池塘; v. 筑成池塘; n. 池塘
example: The path descends to  the pond.
translation: 小路下斜通到池塘。

meaning: n. 邮票；印记；标志；跺脚; v. 铭记；标出；盖章于…；贴邮票于…；用脚踩踏
example: a 29-cent stamp
translation: 一枚 29 美分的邮票

meaning: n. 分数；部分；小部分；稍微
n. 异议，反对；缺陷，缺点；妨碍；拒绝的理由
example: Her objection was that he was too young.
translation: 她反对的理由是他太小。

meaning: adj. 荒凉的；无人烟的; v. 使荒凉；使孤寂
example: a desolate landscape
translation: 荒凉的景色

meaning: v. 烤，焙；烘，烘烤；暴露于某种热力下以得温暖; adj. 烘烤的；烤过的; n. 烤肉；烘烤
example: Are you going to roast the chicken?
translation: 这鸡你是准备烤的吗？

meaning: n. 总部；指挥部；司令部
example: the headquarters of the United Nations
translation: 联合国总部

meaning: n. 到来；到达；到达者
example: Only the timely arrival of the police prevented the situation from becoming worse.
translation: 警方及时赶到才阻止了事态恶化。

meaning: n. 手帕；头巾，围巾
example: Before sweeping the house she bound up her hair in a large handkerchief.
translation: 打扫房屋前， 她把头发用一块大手帕扎起来。

meaning: n. 胃；腹部；胃口; v. 忍受；吃下
example: I was so hungry my stomach hurt.
translation: 我饿得胃都痛了。

meaning: adj. [核] 放射性的；有辐射的
example: the problem of how to dispose of radioactive waste
translation: 如何处理放射性废物的问题

meaning: n. 悲伤；懊悔；伤心事; v. 懊悔；遗憾；感到悲伤
example: the family’s joys and sorrows
translation: 这家人的喜与悲

meaning: n. 油轮；运油飞机；油槽车；坦克手
example: A Greek oil tanker has run aground.
translation: 一艘希腊油轮已经搁浅了。

meaning: v. 旋转；循环; adj. [植] 辐状的
example: The Earth rotates on its axis once every 24 hours.
translation: 地球每24小时绕地轴自转一周。

meaning: v. 使…卷曲；使卷起来; n. 卷曲；卷发；螺旋状物
example: Her lip curled in contempt.
translation: 她轻蔑地撇撇嘴。

meaning: n. 收到；收据；收入; v. 收到
example: Keep your receipt in case you want to bring it back.
translation: 保留收据以备退货之需。

meaning: adj. 积分的；完整的，整体的；构成整体所必须的; n. 积分；部分；完整
example: Rituals, celebrations, and festivals form an integral part of every human society.
translation: 仪式、庆典和节日是每个人类社会不可缺少的组成部分。

meaning: n. 面包；生计; v. 在…上洒面包屑
example: Would you like some bread with your soup?
translation: 你喝汤时要吃点面包吗？

meaning: n. 进口，进口货；输入；意思，含义；重要性; v. 输入，进口；含…的意思
n. 综合，[化学] 合成；综合体
example: speech synthesis software
translation: 语音合成软件

meaning: n. 盒式磁带；暗盒；珠宝箱；片匣
example: His two albums released on cassette have sold 10 million copies.
translation: 他以磁带形式发行的两张专辑已售出1000万份。

meaning: n. 刀；匕首; v. 用刀切；（口）伤害
example: Some young people are carrying knives to defend themselves.
translation: 一些年轻人带着刀子防身。

meaning: n. 蝴蝶；蝶泳；举止轻浮的人；追求享乐的人
example: Gwen’s a real social butterfly .
translation: 格温是个十足的交际花。

meaning: v. 按铃；敲钟；回响；成环形; n. 戒指；铃声，钟声；拳击场；环形物
example: He left Washington with the president’s praises ringing in his ears.
translation: 他离开了华盛顿，总统的赞扬还在他耳际回响。

meaning: n. 福利；幸福；福利事业；安宁; adj. 福利的；接受社会救济的
example: Our only concern is the children’s welfare.
translation: 我们唯一关心的是孩子们的幸福。

meaning: n. 目的地，终点
example: Ellis Island has become one of America's most popular tourist destinations.
translation: 埃利斯岛已经成为美国最受欢迎的游览地之一。

meaning: n. 折扣；贴现率; v. 贴现；打折扣出售商品
example: They are often available at a discount.
translation: 它们经常可以以折扣价买到。

meaning: n. 气体；[矿业] 瓦斯；汽油；毒气; v. 加油；毒（死）
example: hydrogen gas
translation: 氢气

meaning: adj. 快乐的；放荡的；艳丽的; n. 同性恋者
